It’s the first public poll of the general election – and the data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November.

**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.[_Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next? _](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132932975/626165585/416781771?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.08_Brown-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90DO120DC120DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGNkZWRlOC00ZTYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zLCsOqwIH1ICOuZPuL3i37iJ412bPcqDnAI_FH1Mjek=)** | | [ DONATE >> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132932976/626165586/416781771?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.08_Brown-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90DO120DC120DD_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZGNkZWRlOC00ZTYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zLCsOqwIH1ICOuZPuL3i37iJ412bPcqDnAI_FH1Mjek=)

What we’re building together is truly remarkable, and I see it at every stop I make across the state. Folks are fed up with rising costs, rampant corruption, and a rigged system that makes it impossible to get ahead no matter how hard you work. So they’re showing up to make a change and proving that we have the support to flip this seat, even in a state Trump won by 11 points last time.

### Thank you for joining Walker Hoffbeck for Alaska.

We’re running for Governor and Lt. Governor because we know that Alaska is at a crossroads. The state’s future requires an intricate blueprint to guide its course and an experienced team to execute the plan. Our campaign is built on three simple principles:

#### Integrity
Alaskans deserve leaders they can trust. We will govern openly, honestly, and transparently. Decisions will be made based on what is best for Alaska — not political pressure, special interests, or party politics.

#### Experience
Alaska’s challenges are serious. We need leadership that understands energy, budgets, resource development, education, infrastructure, and the realities of governing a large and diverse state. We have the experience to take on these challenges from day one.

#### Solutions
We are not running to maintain the status quo. We are running to solve problems.Our priorities include:
* Bringing the Alaska LNG project to the finish line
* Restoring long-term fiscal stability
* Simplifying Alaska’s oil and gas tax system
* Protecting and strengthening the Permanent Fund for future generations
* Creating stable, predictable funding for education
* Lowering energy costs for Alaskans
* Streamlining permitting and encouraging responsible resource development
* Supporting private-sector growth and good-paying jobs
* Modernizing government and increasing transparency

We also believe Alaska can lead the nation by showing that people with different viewpoints can still work together for the common good.
This campaign is not about political ambition. It is about service. It is about leading with transparency, experience, and a solid plan for Alaska’s future.

Derek, I'm honored to officially be the Democratic nominee for Congress in Virginia’s 10th District!
Securing a Democratic majority in Congress has to be our #1 priority every day between now and November. It’s the only way we can counter the Trump administration’s unbridled corruption and start getting things done for Virginians and Americans.
From the moment he was inaugurated, Trump has made clear over and over again who he’s fighting for: his friends, his Big Money donors, and most of all, himself. His reckless and illegal war of choice in Iran. The constantly rising costs of gas, groceries, and housing here at home. The ongoing cover-up of Jeffrey Epstein’s despicable crimes. Violent anti-immigration tactics from his lethal and untrained ICE agents.
The list goes on — and my Republican colleagues in Congress won’t lift a finger to hold him accountable for any of it.
I came to Congress because I believe Virginians need more leaders in Washington fighting for you, not catering to a corrupt president’s reckless and lawless impulses. From now until Election Day in November, I'll be fighting to keep my seat blue and help flip seats across the Commonwealth and the country so we can deliver the Democratic majority Americans deserve, the oversight the Trump administration requires, and the progress working families need.
If you’re with me in the fight for a Democratic majority in the House, will you split a contribution between my campaign and Tim Kaine before our next FEC filing deadline to help us get ready to win? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026-suhas]

Duke Energy has announced they want to raise rates again.
This time by about 15 percent.
As the Attorney General for North Carolina, I'm your voice to push back, and I just did:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57b71ae6-4060-4f4a-bee3-676ddaf451a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Under state law, Duke is allowed to be a monopoly, but it's not allowed to set its own rates. That's done by the Utilities Commission, so that's where I'm making our case.
We've been building this case for months, it's about 700 pages and you can read it online, but here are the two biggest parts.
First, let's talk money.
For the average family, Duke's request would mean going from paying about $140 a month to about $170 over the next couple years.
A major piece of this is the profit rate. By law, Duke is allowed to earn a profit, but only as much as it needs to meet the growth in the demand for energy.
Right now, Duke can have a 10.1% profit, which brings in about $2 billion each year in net income and makes it one of the most profitable utilities in the country.
Now it's asking to raise its profit to 10.95%.
What our case does is drill all the way down on what Duke _really needs_ to meet demand growth - and we think they overshot the mark.
So we're asking for a reduction in their profit margin to 7.4%, which would save the average family a couple hundred bucks a year.
The second big part of our case is data centers.
We're asking the Utilities Commission to create a separate rate class for them and other very large energy users.
Why?
_Because they 're different._
They use massive amounts of energy, they strain the whole system, and going into this new era we need specific protections to make sure families don't see rates spike because of gigantic new users on the grid.
The Utilities Commission gets to make the ultimate decision, but we've got a strong case to bring rates down and I'll keep you posted.
### Our new case against the Department of Education
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b34b0dad-8aff-4f2b-a5a0-662884af7cdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We just sued the Department of Education on behalf of thousands of student nurses, physician assistants, physical therapists, and other health care workers across North Carolina.
Here's why:
Last year - in the _One Big Beautiful Bill Act_ \- Congress created new limits on financial aid for students.
Whether you agree with that policy or not, Congress is allowed to do that.
It set a higher financial limit for "professional" degrees, because those tend to cost more.
Congress can do that, too.
Then it listed examples of the degrees that count as "professional," to be clear about what was covered.
And it can do that, too.
But then it went to the Department of Education to enforce the new limits, and the department decided to make up its own rules that limited the definition of "professional."
According to the department, that excludes nurses, physician assistants, physical therapists, and lots of other health care workers, which means they won't be treated as "professionals" for their student loans.
And that, _it_ _can 't do._
Once Congress says, "Here's who's eligible, and it includes nurses, physician assistants, etc.," the Department of Education doesn't get to say, "Nah, we'll do our own thing, and it doesn't include those folks."
That's against the law. Departments only have the power Congress gives them. They don't get to turn around and contradict it. Redefining "professional" is the department taking power away from Congress, and the effect would really hurt our state.
In NC, 93 of 100 counties have a primary care shortage. That's why nurse anesthetists are the ones primarily giving anesthesia in 80 percent of rural communities.
These are the exact people this new definition would push out.
As Attorney General, I have a lot of legally complex cases. This isn't one of them. Congress was clear, and I think we're going to do well in court.
And to all the nurses and PAs and PTs out there - thank you for what you do. I'm sorry these guys decided to go after you like this, but we have your back, and they're about to see us in court.
Best,
AG Jeff Jackson

# The ARI Briefing
Breaking Update | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/vQ4QoWD7hoY?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
---|---
Friends, The debate over the preemption of state AI laws is back. On Thursday, a new bill draft called the Great American AI Act proposed a three-year ban on states regulating AI models before deployment. The proposal puts state protections for kids, workers, artists, and civil rights squarely at risk. A [broad coalition of voices](https://us.list-manage.com/HcpRgDafJqx?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) is speaking up about the threat GAAIA poses to a range of state laws. Tomorrow, we're rounding up the experts so you can hear directly from them, [convening](https://us.list-manage.com/MghQ1Wk7ToP?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) union leaders, children's safety advocates, civil rights voices, and legal experts for a virtual panel on what's at stake. Here's the latest, and how you can join us.
| Happening Tomorrow
## The Great American AI Act and State Law Preemption
---
**On Tuesday, June 9 at 1:00 PM ET** , ARI President Brad Carson will moderate a virtual panel examining the preemption proposal and the threat it poses to state AI protections.
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/jnIMJiibFjL?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
The panel brings together a diverse set of leading voices who have raised serious concerns about the bill: **Alejandra Montoya-Boyer** -- VP, Center for Civil Rights & Technology, The Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights **Sara Nelson** -- President, Association of Flight Attendants-CWA **Zamaan Qureshi** -- Co-Founder, Design It For Us **Zephyr Teachout** -- Professor of Law, Fordham Law School The event features a moderated discussion followed by Q&A with reporters and attendees. [RSVP Now ->](https://us.list-manage.com/JUJ5rQuNJn5?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
The Proposal
## A Closer Look at the Preemption Draft
The GAAIA proposal has [raised alarm](https://us.list-manage.com/SFffTAKowaR?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) across DC. The new framework threatens to freeze state regulation of companies that develop AI for the next three years. Specifically, it would block states from enforcing laws that regulate AI model development and pre-release safety decisions. That's the stage where training data is chosen, models are tested, risks are measured, and release decisions are made. At stake are state laws protecting artists and creators, civil rights enforcement, and children online.
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/jqSmnpd7jxK?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
[Read ARI's Statement ->](https://us.list-manage.com/K7Nqu_Jscqd?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) "This bill takes the current floor on state AI legislation and turns it into a federal ceiling, preventing state lawmakers from addressing emerging AI harms in an era of fast-moving technology," said ARI President Brad Carson. The new bill follows months of vocal advocacy from a range of groups speaking out against preemption. Last month, ARI joined with Public Citizen, Demand Progress, Encode, Design It For Us, and Indivisible Massachusetts to [gather petitions](https://us.list-manage.com/NSbrzB4HSGz?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) from MA voters opposed to state law preemption. Last week, a coalition of over [40 national groups](https://us.list-manage.com/lCkbPATbmC7?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf), including artists and creators, environmental groups, and grassroots organizations, wrote to bill sponsors opposing a ban on state laws. And following the release of GAAIA on Thursday, Design It For Us published [a letter](https://us.list-manage.com/ki53iFe6iQ4?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) signed by over 100 youth advocates speaking out against state law preemption. On Tuesday, we'll take the opportunity to dive into some of these concerns, speaking with youth advocates, labor leaders, and civil rights champions. We hope to see you there.
Onward, The ARI Team
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/15ENQnXuCl9?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/IRQaNlqEp2_?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf) [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/YvAJMSM3rSi?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)

The Post Office is enshrined in the US Constitution and created by an act of Congress. Trump’s efforts to unilaterally dismantle it are unconstitutional! 2\. Privatizing USPS would mean higher costs, slower delivery, and the loss of universal service — especially for rural communities, seniors, and people with disabilities. 3\. It’s a threat to our elections. Millions depend on the USPS to vote by mail. Weakening it makes it harder for everyday Americans to participate in our democracy. We can’t allow Trump to dismantle the USPS and privatize it completely. A bombshell new report just revealed that RFK Jr. is quietly directing a massive government-wide effort to search for evidence supporting his long-discredited vaccine theories — including debunked claims linking vaccines to autism. And he’s doing it largely behind closed doors.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
Let me be clear: This effort is not designed to follow the evidence wherever it leads. Its purpose is to justify erroneous conclusions that RFK Jr. already reached years ago.
As a microbiologist, educator, and public health advocate, I cannot overstate how dangerous this is.
Vaccines have saved millions of lives. They are one of the greatest public health achievements in modern history. But instead of investing in research that could actually help families, RFK Jr. is spending tens of millions of taxpayer dollars trying to revive conspiracy theories that have already been exhaustively disproven.
That should alarm every American. Science is supposed to start with evidence — not ideology. You don’t begin with a political agenda and then search for data to justify it. But that’s exactly what’s happening under RFK.
This is why I first ran for office. I saw what happens when politicians override science, spread misinformation, and put ideology ahead of public health.
Now I’m running for Congress because we need more leaders willing to stand up and say clearly: Facts matter. Science matters. Truth matters.

subject: Gabby’s birthday is today

body:
#

Hi friend,
My name is Gloria Giffords. I’m Gabby Giffords’s mom. I stand in awe of my daughter.
I know every mom will tell you her child is perfect, but Gabby is just about as close as it comes.
Growing up, she was always a good kid. She was a loyal friend. And to know Gabby Giffords is to know one thing: _Don’t ever -- not for one moment -- underestimate her._
If she thought she could do something, she put her mind to it until it was done. And to anyone who thought she wasn’t capable of something...well, she quickly proved them wrong.
Our nation has seen what Gabby is capable of since that awful morning in January 2011. It’s been a long road to recovery, but she keeps fighting -- not only for herself, but for families all across our country.
She inspires me every day, and I know I’m not alone.
**There’s a reason why I’m reaching out: Today is Gabby’s birthday, and I wanted to surprise her.**
[**So I want to ask: Will you sign Gabby’s birthday card? You can even leave a personal note if you’d like >>**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_2026_gabbybirthday//?source=em260608-1-b&refcode2=11534.3935704.adBBX8&akid=11534%2E3935704%2EadBBX8)
[](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_q22025_gabbybirthday/?t=1&akid=11534%2E3935704%2EadBBX8)
Growing up, Gabby never asked for anything extravagant (unless you count that one time she wanted a horse). But I know that, more than anything, she wants to make the world safer from gun violence.
And I know she won’t stop fighting until we can achieve that. Together, this movement can help Gabby continue fighting for a safer future.
[**Will you help me celebrate Gabby’s birthday by signing her card today?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_2026_gabbybirthday//?source=em260608-1-b&refcode2=11534.3935704.adBBX8&akid=11534%2E3935704%2EadBBX8)
**[SIGN THE CARD](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_2026_gabbybirthday//?source=em260608-1-b&refcode2=11534.3935704.adBBX8&akid=11534%2E3935704%2EadBBX8)**
This proud mom thanks you for all you’ve done for my Gabby and for this movement. Thank you.
Sincerely,
Gloria Giffords
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/66971?t=2&akid=11534%2E3935704%2EadBBX8)**

Lying is a sacrament in the Church of MAGA, an affirmation of unquestioning loyalty. If you're willing to debase yourself with outrageous dishonesty, welcome to the club.
During Trump's first term, the president and his lackeys didn't want to testify under oath because they might have faced perjury charges if they lied. Republicans called it a "perjury trap." That's as cynical as it gets: Being asked to tell the truth was a "trap."
The news media can't put Republicans under oath, so lying is safer. Corey Lewandowski, the "friend" of disgraced former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, was truthful about his falsehood in 2019, declaring: "I have no obligation to be honest with the media."
I'm not suggesting that all Republicans lie alike. By my count, there are at least 10 different flavors.
**1\. Opposite lying**
"I have some of the best poll numbers I've ever had," Trump said after some of the worst poll numbers he's ever had.
**2\. New-math lying**
Trump's impossible claim that he cut drug prices by 600% is a sign of mental instability. Yet some people laugh it off and Health and Human Services Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr. even defended it. "President Trump has a different way of calculating percentages," said RFK Jr. "There's two ways of calculating percentages. If you have a $600 drug and you reduce it to $10, that's a 600% reduction." No... it's... not.
**3\. Big lying**
Trump and his media mouthpiece, Fox, spread the Big Lie that the 2020 election was rigged. Fox paid a $787 million settlement for its dishonesty, but Trump went unpunished. When the Big Lie fueled a coup attempt, we heard more ridiculous disinformation, such as Rep. Andrew Clyde calling the assault on the Capitol a "normal tourist visit" and Sen. Tom Cotton saying Trump's actions were "core political activity at the heart of our democracy."
**4\. Small lying**
Some Trump dishonesty seems purely for amusement. He installed a plaque at Trump National Golf Club in Sterling, Va., reading: "Many great American soldiers, both of the North and South, died at this spot. The casualties were so great that the water would turn red and thus became known as 'The River of Blood.'" That didn't happen. Totally made up.
**5\. Criminal lying**
Trump, who became a convicted felon because he falsified business records (another form of lying) to cover up his hush-money payment to porn star Stormy Daniels, likes to keep fellow liars around him. Dirty trickster Roger Stone was convicted of lying to Congress. Trump's first national security adviser, Michael Flynn, pleaded guilty to making false statements to the FBI and then tried to withdraw that plea. Bernard Kerik, a Trump ally and former New York City police commissioner convicted of tax fraud and making false statements, spent three years in prison. Another Trump ally, former Rep. George Santos, was convicted of fraud and identity theft.
Trump gave clemency to all four. Stone, Flynn, and Kerik received pardons, while Santos got his sentence commuted, which wiped out court-ordered restitution for his victims.

**6\. Righteous lying**
Sometimes Republicans admit they're lying, but say they're doing it for the greater good. JD Vance defended his hoax about Haitian migrants eating dogs and cats by saying, "If I have to create stories so that the American media actually pays attention to the suffering of the American people, then that's what I'm going to do."
**7\. Know-nothing lying**
When reporters ask House Speaker Mike Johnson about a controversy, he often claims to know nothing about it. If he was really that ignorant, he should be removed as speaker. Instead he's blatantly lying... which means he should be removed as speaker.
**8\. Tag-team lying**
On April 30, Sen. Tim Scott and Rep. Steve Scalise found two different ways to lie about the same thing.
Scott claimed: "Gas prices continue to come down." In fact, the average price for regular gasoline on that date was $4.30 a gallon, up 27 cents from a week earlier and up $1.12 from a year earlier. Steve Scalise claimed that "two years ago, we were paying almost $6 a gallon. Right now it's in the $3s." Nope. It was $4.30 when Scalise said that, and two years earlier it was $3.65, not even close to $6.
When Republicans lie like this, there's often a lack of media pushback, but after Scalise's dishonesty, CNBC's Joe Kernen called him out. In Scott's case, however, Fox Business' Maria Bartiromo just ignored the lie and moved on.
**9\. Predictive lying**
Before Trump's election in 2024, transition co-chair Howard Lutnick denied that RFK Jr. would become Secretary of Health and Human Services. "He's not going to be the secretary! No!" Lutnick said. Of course, RFK Jr. got the job. Lutnick also said Trump wouldn't consider hiring people tied to Project 2025 because they were "radioactive." Of course, Trump did hire them.
**10\. Lying about lying**
Beware when Trump's press secretaries promise to tell the truth.
Kayleigh McEnany pledged: "I will never lie to you." Then she claimed falsely that the Mueller Report was "a complete and total exoneration of President Trump." It wasn't, of course.
Karoline Leavitt said: "I commit to telling the truth from this podium every single day." Then she claimed fraud fighter Trump stopped about $50 million from going "out the door to fund condoms in Gaza." Separately, Trump said Hamas planned to use the condoms to build bombs. But the condoms were not for Hamas. They were for the prevention of sexually transmitted diseases in a province of the African nation of Mozambique called Gaza – a totally different place than the Middle East version of Gaza.
That's how Republicans roll.

After four decades in newsrooms, I've watched Republican dishonesty get more brazen and more varied. So I sorted it into 10 distinct flavors — from "opposite lying" to "lying about lying" — because naming the pattern is the first step to fighting it. = = Thanks for being in this fight, Mark Jacob COURIER Contributor = Lying is a sacrament in the Church of MAGA, an affirmation of unquestioning loyalty. If you're willing to debase yourself with outrageous dishonesty, welcome to the club. During Trump's first term, the president and his lackeys didn't want to testify under oath because they might have faced perjury charges if they lied. Republicans called it a "perjury trap." That's as cynical as it gets: Being asked to tell the truth was a "trap." The news media can't put Republicans under oath, so lying is safer. Corey Lewandowski, the "friend" of disgraced former Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, was truthful about his falsehood in 2019, declaring: "I have no obligation to be honest with the media." I'm not suggesting that all Republicans lie alike. By my count, there are at least 10 different flavors. 1\. Opposite lying "I have some of the best poll numbers I've ever had," Trump said after some of the worst poll numbers he's ever had. 2\. New-math lying Trump's impossible claim that he cut drug prices by 600% is a sign of mental instability. Yet some people laugh it off and Health and Human Services Secretary Robert Kennedy Jr. even defended it. "President Trump has a different way of calculating percentages," said RFK Jr. "There's two ways of calculating percentages. If you have a $600 drug and you reduce it to $10, that's a 600% reduction." No... it's... not. 3\. Big lying Trump and his media mouthpiece, Fox, spread the Big Lie that the 2020 election was rigged. Fox paid a $787 million settlement for its dishonesty, but Trump went unpunished. When the Big Lie fueled a coup attempt, we heard more ridiculous disinformation, such as Rep. Andrew Clyde calling the assault on the Capitol a "normal tourist visit" and Sen. Tom Cotton saying Trump's actions were "core political activity at the heart of our democracy." 4\. Small lying Some Trump dishonesty seems purely for amusement. He installed a plaque at Trump National Golf Club in Sterling, Va., reading: "Many great American soldiers, both of the North and South, died at this spot. The casualties were so great that the water would turn red and thus became known as 'The River of Blood.'" That didn't happen. Totally made up. 5\. Criminal lying Trump, who became a convicted felon because he falsified business records (another form of lying) to cover up his hush-money payment to porn star Stormy Daniels, likes to keep fellow liars around him. Dirty trickster Roger Stone was convicted of lying to Congress. Trump's first national security adviser, Michael Flynn, pleaded guilty to making false statements to the FBI and then tried to withdraw that plea. Bernard Kerik, a Trump ally and former New York City police commissioner convicted of tax fraud and making false statements, spent three years in prison. Another Trump ally, former Rep. George Santos, was convicted of fraud and identity theft. Trump gave clemency to all four. Stone, Flynn, and Kerik received pardons, while Santos got his sentence commuted, which wiped out court-ordered restitution for his victims. = 6\. Righteous lying Sometimes Republicans admit they're lying, but say they're doing it for the greater good. JD Vance defended his hoax about Haitian migrants eating dogs and cats by saying, "If I have to create stories so that the American media actually pays attention to the suffering of the American people, then that's what I'm going to do." 7\. Know-nothing lying When reporters ask House Speaker Mike Johnson about a controversy, he often claims to know nothing about it. If he was really that ignorant, he should be removed as speaker. Instead he's blatantly lying... which means he should be removed as speaker. 8\. Tag-team lying On April 30, Sen. Tim Scott and Rep. Steve Scalise found two different ways to lie about the same thing. Scott claimed: "Gas prices continue to come down." In fact, the average price for regular gasoline on that date was $4.30 a gallon, up 27 cents from a week earlier and up $1.12 from a year earlier. Steve Scalise claimed that "two years ago, we were paying almost $6 a gallon. Right now it's in the $3s." Nope. It was $4.30 when Scalise said that, and two years earlier it was $3.65, not even close to $6. When Republicans lie like this, there's often a lack of media pushback, but after Scalise's dishonesty, CNBC's Joe Kernen called him out. In Scott's case, however, Fox Business' Maria Bartiromo just ignored the lie and moved on. 9\. Predictive lying Before Trump's election in 2024, transition co-chair Howard Lutnick denied that RFK Jr. would become Secretary of Health and Human Services. "He's not going to be the secretary! No!" Lutnick said. Of course, RFK Jr. got the job. Lutnick also said Trump wouldn't consider hiring people tied to Project 2025 because they were "radioactive." Of course, Trump did hire them. 10\. Lying about lying Beware when Trump's press secretaries promise to tell the truth. Kayleigh McEnany pledged: "I will never lie to you." Then she claimed falsely that the Mueller Report was "a complete and total exoneration of President Trump." It wasn't, of course. Karoline Leavitt said: "I commit to telling the truth from this podium every single day." Then she claimed fraud fighter Trump stopped about $50 million from going "out the door to fund condoms in Gaza." Separately, Trump said Hamas planned to use the condoms to build bombs. But the condoms were not for Hamas. They were for the prevention of sexually transmitted diseases in a province of the African nation of Mozambique called Gaza – a totally different place than the Middle East version of Gaza. That's how Republicans roll. = Email us: mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com =

body:
Colorado has problems. Both parties agree on that.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 8, 2026** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
This week, Rocky Mountain Voice's editorial board made an observation that stood out after watching both the Republican and Democratic gubernatorial debates:
For all their disagreements, the candidates agreed on one thing. _**[Colorado has problems.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
Housing is too expensive. Businesses are leaving. Families are struggling to afford the state they've called home for generations. Even the candidates who have spent years in positions of power acknowledged that Colorado is becoming harder to afford, harder to build in, and harder to keep businesses in.
The real debate wasn't whether those problems exist. It was [who should be trusted to fix them.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Republicans spent much of their debate arguing over who can finally break the party's statewide losing streak. Democrats spent much of theirs discussing what needs to change in Colorado.
And that leaves voters with a question only they can answer: If nearly everyone agrees there are warning lights flashing on the dashboard, who do you trust behind the wheel?
Read the full editorial piece here ➡ _**[Five candidates agreed Colorado has problems. Voters must decide who owns them](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
Ballots are arriving, the primary is underway, and Colorado voters are about to make one of the most consequential decisions in recent state history.
**🇺🇸[Freedom Festival is only 18 DAYS AWAY!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** Speaking of Colorado's future... We're officially 18 days away from Freedom Fest and excitement is building fast.
This week we're thrilled to announce that **U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright** will be joining our speaker lineup. As the nation's top energy official and a longtime Colorado entrepreneur, Wright has been at the center of some of the most important conversations surrounding American energy independence, affordability, innovation, and economic growth.
And if you're interested in meeting the candidates you'll be voting on that week in the primary, you'll be especially interested in **Saturday's Candidate Meet & Greet**, where attendees will have the opportunity to meet and hear directly from candidates seeking to lead Colorado into its next chapter.
Add that to an incredible lineup featuring: 🔥 Greg Gutfeld
🔥 Lara Logan
🔥 Nick Shirley
🔥 Chris Wright
🔥 Dr. Kevin Roberts
🔥 Dog the Bounty Hunter
🔥 Dr. Robert Malone
🔥 Dr. James Lindsay
🔥 Data Republican
🔥 Pastor Lorenzo Sewell
🔥 Seth Keshel
🔥 Mike Davis
🔥 Larry Gatlin
🔥 Beverly Vance Aikins
🔥 Erin Lee
Plus: 🎶 Live music
🤠 Rodeo events
🎡 Family Fun Fair
🚁 Massive patriotic drone show
🍔 Food trucks and vendors
This isn't just another political event. It's a celebration of freedom, faith, family, and the future of Colorado and America. With only 18 days to go, now is the time to secure your tickets. We can't wait to see you there.
👉 **[Get your tickets now!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
In truth & liberty,
Team RMV
---
| | |
---
| | **TOP STORIES OF THE WEEK**
---
**[The marijuana money for Colorado schools shrank. A 2025 law decided where the rest goes.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) For years the story about Colorado’s marijuana taxes and its schools ran in one direction. Sales climbed, revenue climbed, and a share of it went to a fund that helps districts repair aging buildings. When sales started falling, the natural assumption followed. Less marijuana money, less for schools.

**[Colorado became a national model for mail voting. Election Integrity Network says it should go back.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The ballot simply shows up weeks before Election Day. Some ballots are filled out the day they arrive. Others sit untouched until the weekend. Too many, most will argue, end up ignored. Eventually, a lot are mailed, taken to a drop box or walked into a polling center. It’s the only system younger voters have ever known. __
**[Prose that just happens to rhyme: Larry Gatlin on books, faith and the America worth passing on](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Soccer wasn’t really happening for Royal Gatlin. The three-year-old was on the field as a player, technically. But he was picking little purple clovers for his mother and bringing them to her. When the game break came, Royal found a package of Goldfish crackers in his baby brother Walker’s stroller and grabbed it.
|
---
**STATE**
**[Colorado’s prison problem is underfunding. The legislature’s answer was early release.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) On May 19, Gov. Jared Polis signed two bills that will accelerate the release of inmates from Colorado’s prisons. No ceremony. No bill-specific statement. The governor’s office issued an administrative notice listing six pieces of legislation and went about its day.
__
**[Colorado protected school funding without touching TABOR refunds. Now it wants those too.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Last session, the Colorado General Assembly passed a bill asking voters to waive their TABOR refunds to fund education. The ballot title calls it “without raising taxes.” No rates change.

**[I won’t surrender my speech rights: Why I’m challenging Colorado’s gender identity mandates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[FAIR FOR ALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _I consider myself a law-abiding person. I’ve never seen a jail cell, I’ve never been sued. I’ve gotten one speeding ticket (I was driving to the airport and was concerned I would miss my flight) and two parking tickets (both times were unintentional). I begrudgingly pay my taxes — on time and always respect the rights of others.
_
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Federal Officials Give Jeffco School District 10 Days To Address Girls Sports Findings](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The U.S. Department of Education (ED) sent a warning letter to the Jefferson County Public Schools in Colorado on Wednesday, after the department determined in March that the school district may have allegedly put up to 61 male students on girls’ sports teams, Fox News Digital previously reported.

**[Lakewood taxpayers face 30-year shelter obligation after city grant deal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _From a recent edition of the Lakewood Informer: “Lakewood purchased 8000 W Colfax Avenue to use as an emergency shelter and Navigation Center using a grant from the state to fund the property purchase and renovation. As a condition to getting the grant, Lakewood committed the property to shelter use for 30 years."_
**[Court Orders Release of Larimer Autopsy Report in Transparency Dispute](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Abortion is obviously a polarizing topic. While this column touches on the subject, it’s not the actual focus. Rather, it’s about something I hope we can all agree on: transparency. Government officials should not be hiding information from us based on what they think is good for us to know, or for some ideological reason; a lesson the Larimer County Coroner recently learned the hard way._

**_[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[When government defrauds the citizen, it forfeits its moral claim to tax him](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _There comes a point at which taxation ceases to be civic contribution and becomes state extraction. That point is reached when citizen taxpayers are defrauded by their own government, when public money is lost, stolen, concealed, misdirected, or protected through official corruption, and when the same government that demands payment from the citizen refuses justice to the citizen._ __
**[Buying American is about more than the price tag](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KAREN POST, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _This year, our country turns 250. Anniversaries are not just markers of time — they are moments of reflection. What kind of America do we want to be for the next 250 years? My answer is simple: one that invests in its own prosperity._
__
**[Taxpayers on the Hook When Government Programs Cost More Than Promised](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Colorado’s state budget is structurally unsustainable, which majority Democrats say could be fixed by ending voter consent over new taxation or by increasing taxes on Colorado residents through a progressive income tax._
__
**_[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[EPA Boss Alleges Billions In Green Grants Were Funneled Through Democrat Linked Groups](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[JUST THE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Environmental Protection Agency Administrator Lee Zeldin says he has made several criminal referrals after uncovering a major political enrichment scandal that routed billions in Biden-era green energy grants to Democrat cronies. “It’s about self-dealing,” Zeldin tells Just the News.
**[Turn down the noise: Why Steve Pearce’s BLM confirmation isn’t the crisis critics claim](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[GREGWALCHER.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _This week the Senate finally confirmed the new Director of the Bureau of Land Management, former New Mexico Congressman Steve Pearce. The firestorm surrounding his nomination a few weeks earlier has not yet cooled and probably won’t. The volume is louder than the situation justifies, though, and the vast western sky above BLM land is not falling._
__
**[Sheriffs and Prosecutors Push Back Against Democrat Governors’ Leftist Agendas](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**[JUST THE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Two Democrat governors trying to advance progressive policies on immigration and gun control are facing pushback from local law enforcement, with sheriffs and prosecutors in Maryland and Virginia openly resisting portions of the states’ new agendas.

Friend, Right now, across Tennessee, _**a quiet crisis is unfolding right in our backyards.**_ _****_ From Memphis to Nashville, _**massive tech conglomerates**_ are rushing to build high-density _AI data centers._ They make big promises about the future, but _behind closed doors_ , they are straining our power grids, threatening our local environments, and risking the natural resources that belong to you, the people of Tennessee. We are seeing it right now next to the Nashville Zoo, where developers want to build a massive, _**69,000-square-foot data center**_ just feet away from vulnerable wildlife, with zero public environmental impact studies.__**_Jerri stands with residents of Nashville who have already gathered [o](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132941101/626192097/1021463262?refcode=06.08_AI_Accountability&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMWMyNTQ3OS01YjYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5pWYqHkoc8tftyXkfljqR-ajEa7jpifYqQ0ViEVlC1c=&emci=1997a0b1-4a63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=01c25479-5b63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)_[ver 300,000 signatures on their petition](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132941104/626192099/1021463262?refcode=06.08_AI_Accountability&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMWMyNTQ3OS01YjYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5pWYqHkoc8tftyXkfljqR-ajEa7jpifYqQ0ViEVlC1c=&emci=1997a0b1-4a63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=01c25479-5b63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271) to stop this landgrab.** | | [Petition: Nashville Zoo Says No to Proposed Data Center](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132941106/626192101/-903599789?refcode=06.08_AI_Accountability&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMWMyNTQ3OS01YjYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5pWYqHkoc8tftyXkfljqR-ajEa7jpifYqQ0ViEVlC1c=&emci=1997a0b1-4a63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=01c25479-5b63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)

We’ve seen it in Memphis, when recently, _**Elon Musk’s xAI abruptly paused development on the critical greywater reuse facility**_ they promised to build, a facility meant to protect _our most precious natural resource_ , **the Memphis Sand Aquifer.**
**But Jerri Green isn't waiting around for corporations to _police themselves._**
As an attorney and Memphis City Councilwoman, Jerri is already taking the fight directly to them. **On May 29th, Jerri sent a formal letter to the Memphis Mayor Paul Young’s administration and the City Attorney,** calling for answers and putting them on notice to outline the legal remedies, contract enforcement mechanisms, and penalties available to hold these tech executives accountable to their promises.
_"It is important for both the Council and the public to understand the City's ability to_
_ensure compliance with any commitments that have been made." — _Councilwoman Jerri Green__
Jerri knows that _"taking their word for it"_ is not a wise strategy. Whether it is _**protecting the 3,000 animals at the Nashville Zoo**_ or _**safeguarding the drinking water of millions of families**_ , Tennessee needs a leader who understands _how to use the law, leverage, and political willpower_ to _**put people over corporate handouts. **_As your next Governor, Jerri will _scale this fight statewide._ Her _**Responsible AI Platform**_ is built on a simple premise: **Tech companies must pay their fair share, respect our resources, and protect our workers.**
_**Here is how she will deliver safety and accountability back to Tennessee communities:**_
* **Water Conservation:** Protect our drinking water by legally requiring tech companies to use recycled greywater—not our clean aquifer water—to cool their massive servers.
* **Energy Cost Protection:** Ensure tech companies pay for their own immense energy consumption so that local families aren’t stuck with skyrocketing electric bills.

Hi, it's Lisa. Do you have a few minutes to spare? I want to share a personal story with you, but I know you're busy, so if you can't read this whole email, I totally understand. **[Before you go, will you consider donating $10 to help me hit my daily fundraising goal and take back the Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132941922/626195118/1350224564?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.08_Scarf-2026_B1_F1_S1_C1_210DONx90DO_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWRjOTJlNS01YjYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RLPJ8hoJszjJG_cZgo7slFG1lzlBMDyB94kG_x0PJtM=)**

This scarf carries enormous personal significance to me. If you look closely, you can see that it's imprinted with the very document that granted my great-great-great-grandfather, who was formerly enslaved, the right to vote. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132941923/626195119/-499167411?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.08_Scarf-2026_B1_F1_S1_C1_210DONx90DO_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OWRjOTJlNS01YjYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RLPJ8hoJszjJG_cZgo7slFG1lzlBMDyB94kG_x0PJtM=) 148 years after my great-great-great-grandfather was issued that document, I wore this scarf the day I was sworn into the House of Representatives in 2017. In 2025, I proudly wore it again when I was sworn in as the first woman and person of color to represent Delaware in the Senate. I even had this scarf with me on the day of the January 6th insurrection, when I was trapped on a balcony in the House chamber as violent rioters stormed the U.S. Capitol. On such a dark day, my scarf served as a reminder that, while our democracy may be fragile, it will _**always**_ be worth fighting for. The story this scarf tells has come full-circle. | Peter,
All hell has broken loose in Louisiana. Starting on April 28th, 2026, MAGA began an all out assault on Louisiana's democratic system, a coup, which to this day has still not relented.
Following the Supreme Court decision to gut the Voting Rights Act, they cancelled our elections, threw out over 42,000 ballots, and introduced a segregated Jim Crow era map that erases one of our Black majority districts.
We face nothing short of the permanent extinction of Democratic power here in Louisiana and we are outmanned and outgunned.
However, despite the steep odds we face, Democrats from across the nation have stepped up. Over 64,000 individual donors contributed a combined $1.7 million dollars to our party helping fuel an unprecedented Democratic victory in our May 16th elections, the first election since the SCOTUS ruling against the VRA.
And now key leaders like Gavin Newsom, US Senator Cory Booker, and former Vice President Kamala Harris who just announced she will head to New Orleans, are wading in to join our fight against the disenfranchisement of over 1.5 million Black voters:
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001omqHs8qOBuTuldU0H5ytbJ-z4YpPVd6Xi7AmaveVbjNqF72sHJejTFCWg4XXIFHGChXdJn9kogT7JSM9Gv-fnuQ-qmh2MGV4AIjXiibSCIFfIGG0vk3KKKvzkE8mGTOVKtS3joFT-WGj5_-WMYEB4EkWqM0wVGGII03NnE2VwGHRLhzte5WXJqJZDxXVrLZmjjOnfoRHdYjY3uH5V7jODcgNQCKnL030&c=UeyFcZ-VJFSiKV80X7vN7Z1xzRiD9HC3JmAL-DLQIc-NR8rFpC_wwA==&ch=GHoJbnnfAzeCnjKoq0mdgKl5AvuVnVDH0D-99NEUU0PMfhGWit_V9A==)
---
The battle lines are being drawn in real time. Powerful forces are amassing on both sides. Republicans are scared because they know Democrats can win in their own backyard.
To do our part in 2026 Louisiana Democrats have this gargantuan task in front of us:

* Defend incumbent Congressman Cleo Fields and Congressman Troy Carter from MAGA attempts to unseat them. MAGA has already come for Congressman Cleo Fields' district but Carter's district may now be next on the redistricting chopping block.

* Flip Louisiana's red US Senate Seat and elect Louisiana's first Black US Senator, Democrat Jamie Davis.

* Compete in all four of Louisiana's 4 red Congressional districts -- for the first time in many years Louisiana Dems have a candidate vying for each seat.

Democrats performed so well on May 16th, so many women and Black voters showed up, and MAGA's 5 constitutional amendments were rejected so mightily, that James Carville said Democrats have a "fighting chance" to flip the US Senate seat in Louisiana this year.
There was never supposed to be a fight of this magnitude in Louisiana and MAGA is panicking. If they lose the Deep South, there is no coming back from this.
[So please, will you join Kamala Harris and tens of thousands of your fellow Democrats to stand by the side of the Louisiana Democratic Party. We are facing everything that MAGA can throw at us and a donation of $50, $25, or even just $5 will help Louisiana Democrats continue carrying on our fight.](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001omqHs8qOBuTuldU0H5ytbJ-z4YpPVd6Xi7AmaveVbjNqF72sHJejTFCWg4XXIFHGnfo5DEKY9HM7zL6GT6mC2U0kokZ7K1PTNbcMtPNCUwgPeQdYi8OHHYSJMG1AvsuwWatJw8b2GR6v_-Ai3Y8bpQHZ3ijD2olX-GDeCq3Z65jHWBuzulkbZiW9CaiU3W0ucKic0AnP73mWmL0IBEqEf9g99cnYTiId1iEmt7srr8Q=&c=UeyFcZ-VJFSiKV80X7vN7Z1xzRiD9HC3JmAL-DLQIc-NR8rFpC_wwA==&ch=GHoJbnnfAzeCnjKoq0mdgKl5AvuVnVDH0D-99NEUU0PMfhGWit_V9A==)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132943049/626199495/1026369139?refcode=260608_RG_toddblanche-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiOTYxMzY5MC01ZTYzLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JGUuutp9FWRjkUSvqhnt5kS3qx6B5mX27fPlvx1m10A=&emci=4b79b32b-4563-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=b9613690-5e63-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=16877361)

**[So I'm asking you to take a stand with me and add your name to my grassroots petition demanding that Todd Blanche be FIRED immediately. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hi there,
The way we teach history shapes how the next generation sees America—and right now, that story is changing.
This past Wednesday, I took a closer look at how American history is presented in classrooms today. And what I found was striking. According to a Northwestern University Institute for Policy Research survey, 73% of Americans are dissatisfied with the way the subject is taught in public schools.
That stat tells you everything—parents across the political spectrum recognize that something is wrong.
As you know, these new curricula emphasize systemic challenges and injustices. **Students graduate without understanding the full story—the courage, sacrifice, and vision that built this nation. That's one reason the work of the Moving Picture Institute (MPI) matters so much to me. At MPI, we make movies that highlight the ideals of freedom, character, and service, and help bring these important stories to life for new audiences.**
And this matters more now than ever before. A generation is growing up without access to the stories and films that you and I had. We grew up with movies like _D-Day_ , _Davy Crocket_ , _The Alamo_ , _Top Gun_ —heck, just 20 years ago they made _The Patriot_.
But MPI is counteracting that by making a movie for families with children.
**Son of 1776** is an animated film where a young patriot joins George Washington and experiences the American Revolution. Children and families will see the bravery and sacrifice that forged this great nation. This is a movie that WILL celebrate America's 250th birthday.

clean_body: Counteracting Classroom Propaganda Son of 1776 needs your support to reach millions of young Americans with the true story of America's founding. Hi there, The way we teach history shapes how the next generation sees America—and right now, that story is changing. This past Wednesday, I took a closer look at how American history is presented in classrooms today. And what I found was striking. According to a Northwestern University Institute for Policy Research survey, 73% of Americans are dissatisfied with the way the subject is taught in public schools. That stat tells you everything—parents across the political spectrum recognize that something is wrong. As you know, these new curricula emphasize systemic challenges and injustices. Students graduate without understanding the full story—the courage, sacrifice, and vision that built this nation. That's one reason the work of the Moving Picture Institute (MPI) matters so much to me. At MPI, we make movies that highlight the ideals of freedom, character, and service, and help bring these important stories to life for new audiences. And this matters more now than ever before. A generation is growing up without access to the stories and films that you and I had. We grew up with movies like D-Day , Davy Crocket , The Alamo , Top Gun —heck, just 20 years ago they made The Patriot. But MPI is counteracting that by making a movie for families with children. Son of 1776 is an animated film where a young patriot joins George Washington and experiences the American Revolution. Children and families will see the bravery and sacrifice that forged this great nation. This is a movie that WILL celebrate America's 250th birthday. | | ---|---|--- | | Sincerely, Joseph Corey Vice President of Philanthropic Investments The Moving Picture Institute | 375 Greenwich Street New York NY 10013

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240892%2E444211%2ENELxzt)
Powered by People exists to help Democrats win big elections in Texas. And there is no bigger election this year than the one for U.S. Senate.
If James Talarico is going to be the first Democrat to win here since Lloyd Bentsen did in 1988; if he’s going to be the 51st vote in the Senate to fight corruption, bring down prices and stop Trump from destroying this country; if his victory will help us win other big races for Governor, Congress and the State House... then we’ve got to pull out all the stops.
That’s why, in addition to our successful statewide voter registration and voter turnout program on college campuses, we are now adding more innovative and yes, expensive, programs that give our volunteers new opportunities to connect with Texans who otherwise might not vote.
We have just partnered on a program that is mailing voter registration forms to hundreds of thousands of likely Democrats who have moved and have not yet updated their voter registration. This week, our volunteers will be calling more than 130,000 of them to assist them in the process, to make sure they are able to legally vote at their new address and then offer to personally stay in touch with them to answer any follow up questions.
And — importantly! — our volunteers will stay in touch with them to ensure that they have the necessary reminders to cast their ballot and won’t stop reaching out until we’ve confirmed that they have voted.
I lost to Ted Cruz by a little more than 215,000 votes in 2018.
What if we’d had a program like this one back then? Imagine the hundreds of thousands of voters we could have reached and brought into that critical election.
Well, we have the chance to do it now.
So let’s make the most of it. **This program will cost $66,000 to cover the texts, calls, and contact data needed to reach all of these Texans.**
[**Can you pitch in today to make sure we get it done?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260608.EyJxAK&refcode=ema20260608-240892&t=3&akid=240892%2E444211%2ENELxzt)

Thank you,
Beto

# Iran ends strikes on Israel
but Lebanon risks linger
Iran said Monday it **[has halted military strikes against Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/6b0a0de3-4c84-47af-90cc-700295581d08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Sunday's first clash since an April ceasefire, but warned that continued Israeli operations in Lebanon could trigger renewed escalation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b0a0de3-4c84-47af-90cc-700295581d08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Military Operations Halted:** Iran's foreign ministry confirmed cessation of strikes after the missile exchange but reserved rights if IDF actions in Lebanon continue.
* **Lebanon Strikes Risk Escalation:** Tehran warned it would resume hostilities if Israel persists with its campaign including the Beirut suburbs attack.
* **Trump Pushes Ceasefire:** The president posted both sides seek an immediate ceasefire with negotiations proceeding and the blockade remaining until a final deal.
* **Oil Prices Pull Back:** Prices eased from session highs after surging more than 5 percent amid the tensions.

* * *
* * *
# Oil prices pull back after
Trump ceasefire push
Oil prices rose Monday on Iran-Israel strikes **[but pulled back after President Trump announced](https://substack.com/redirect/f69f47f3-2bb2-4b1e-8610-199ae0666516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** both sides seek a ceasefire as Iran declared an end to military operations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f69f47f3-2bb2-4b1e-8610-199ae0666516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Benchmark Prices Advanced:** Brent crude rose 1.6 percent to $94.59 while WTI jumped 1.8 percent to $92.18 before retreating from highs.
* **Iran Ends Operations:** Iran's armed forces announced military operations against Israel concluded after missile launches in retaliation for Lebanon campaign.
* **OPEC Output Increase:** OPEC+ agreed to raise production targets by 188,000 barrels per day from July marking the fourth quota hike.
* **Trump Signals Ceasefire:** The president posted that Iran and Israel are looking to agree to a ceasefire with final deal negotiations proceeding.

# EchoStar stock surges 430%
after SpaceX deal
A beleaguered satellite company EchoStar **[has become the Fortune 500's latest success story](https://substack.com/redirect/99f5003f-88df-4afd-9646-84e65faea60e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in shareholder returns after selling spectrum to SpaceX for $17 billion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/99f5003f-88df-4afd-9646-84e65faea60e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Spectrum Sale Turnaround:** EchoStar sold wireless spectrum to SpaceX for $17 billion with half cash and half equity plus later additional sales.
* **Stock Performance Boom:** Shares soared 430 percent since the beginning of last year including nearly 375 percent in 2025 alone.
* **SpaceX Equity Stake:** The deals left EchoStar with $11.1 billion in SpaceX stock turning it into a proxy ahead of the IPO.
* **Bankruptcy Averted:** The company was preparing Chapter 11 filing amid FCC probe but recovered after Trump pushed the spectrum sale.

* * *
* * *
# Microsoft launches China AI incubator sparking fears
Microsoft is quietly helping launch an incubator for Chinese tech startups providing AI technologies and global ecosystem access, **[reigniting Washington concerns over Beijing ties.](https://substack.com/redirect/2355d649-c95b-49ae-81d6-10cb009a8c83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2355d649-c95b-49ae-81d6-10cb009a8c83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Shenzhen Center Unveiled:** The Global Expansion Center was launched last month with local Communist Party officials alongside Microsoft executives.
* **AI Support Offered:** Microsoft will provide local firms with its AI technologies, platform capabilities and access to its global network.
* **Lawmaker Criticism:** The House Select Committee on China said Microsoft should reconsider helping China's AI technology efforts over national security risks.
* **Company Downplays Role:** Microsoft called it a marketing and advertising training initiative that is not conducting research or receiving government funding.

# Bidding war erupts for the
world's oldest bank
A **[bidding war has erupted](https://substack.com/redirect/acddfb67-aef3-456b-b63d-ee67e5200056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for Italy's Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS), the world's oldest bank, as Intesa Sanpaolo announced a 30.6 billion euro unsolicited offer to top rival Banco BPM's merger interest.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/acddfb67-aef3-456b-b63d-ee67e5200056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Intesa Unsolicited Offer:** Intesa proposed 30.6 billion euros at a 12.5 percent premium versus MPS closing share price on Friday.
* **BPM Merger Plan:** Banco BPM's board approved expressing interest in a merger of equals giving both groups equal weight in the entity.
* **MPS Background:** The bank received a state bailout in 2017, was re-privatized in 2023 and acquired Mediobanca last year.
* **Share Reactions Mixed:** Intesa and BPM shares fell while MPS shares rose 0.9 percent in early trade on Monday.

NYT: Trump Signs Order Seeking Federal Control of Mail Voting as He Promotes False Claims [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=060826_2&amount=25]
Straight from the New York Times , Team:
" President Trump stepped up efforts to promote his false claims of widespread voting fraud, signing an executive order of questionable constitutionality seeking to create a national list of citizens that would determine voting eligibility and restrict mail ballots. "
Let's be clear: The president has no explicit Constitutional authority over elections, and much of this latest attack on our fundamental right to vote appears difficult to enforce and legally dubious.
This order directs the Department of Homeland Security to create a “ state citizenship list ” based on data from various federal databases. It also directs federal officials to send that made-up list to state election officials, and orders the attorney general to prioritize prosecution of election officials who provide ballots to voters not on the made-up list. It also directs the U.S. Postal Service not to transmit mail-in ballots from any individual not included on Trump's “ state citizenship list ," even though elections are mandated by the constitutional the be run by the states.
This order is yet another sign that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.

name: LeftNet
subject: Happy Pride! 🏳️‍🌈
body:
Republicans are passing laws to erase queer people from public life.
#
Happy Pride! 🏳️🌈
What started out as a protest has since become a celebration of visibility, resilience, and love — but it’s _also_ a call to action. This month, as we honor the contributions and sacrifices queer people have made to make our country a better place for all, we must also confront a painful truth: **the LGBTQ+ community is under attack.**
Across the nation, extremist Republican lawmakers are passing a wave of anti-LGBTQ+ legislation, banning drag performances, targeting trans youth, banning books, and stripping away queer folks’ humanity.
But we’re not powerless. **And we aren’t alone.**
Several groups are leading these fights — in courts, state legislatures, and beyond to ensure the safety of LGBTQ+ folks. **And right now, they could really use your help.**
**[This Pride Month, will you chip in $5 to support grassroots organizations fighting back against the GOP’s campaign of hate?](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260608.wvm18U&refcode=em20260608-1653&amount=5&t=1&akid=1653%2E2118727%2EtpDmSf)**
_Your contribution will be split between the following organizations: Human Rights Campaign (HRC), The Trevor Project, and PFLAG:_ **
**
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260608.wvm18U&refcode=em20260608-1653&amount=5&t=2&akid=1653%2E2118727%2EtpDmSf)**
The attacks on the LGBTQ+ community come at a time when other groups are also facing similar threats. Taken together, these attacks paint a damning picture: our rights and democracy are being threatened by an increasingly radical right-wing that will do anything and everything to see through their agenda.
This isn’t just political theater. It’s a coordinated attack to erase queer people from public life.
We’ve been here before. And we know that in times like these, it will take all of us to rise up together in solidarity against the hatred, violence, and homophobia levied at people simply for being who they are. **Lives are on the line.**
Our moment to rise is now. Because Pride isn’t just a party — it’s a promise. A promise that we will fight for each other. A promise that we will show up. And a promise that we will never, ever allow ourselves to go back in time.
[**If you can spare a few dollars, please pitch in $5 now to power the work of these critical LGBTQ+ groups and stand against the GOP’s efforts to marginalize queer people.** ](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260608.wvm18U&refcode=em20260608-1653&amount=5&t=3&akid=1653%2E2118727%2EtpDmSf)
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21450?c0=leftnet_em20260608.wvm18U&refcode=em20260608-1653&amount=5&t=4&akid=1653%2E2118727%2EtpDmSf)**
With pride and resolve,
LeftNet

clean_body: | | | I’m Josh Turek. I’m a Democratic state legislator who won a deep red seat, four-time Paralympian, and two-time gold medalist in wheelchair basketball. I thought the feeling of winning my first gold medal at the 2016 Rio Paralympics would only come once in a lifetime. But, then my race was called: I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Iowa’s open U.S. Senate seat. Friend, grassroots energy usually peaks in the first few days after a primary, so we have to get down to business ASAP. | I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me, and I’m ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat and be the champion working people deserve in Washington. I got into this race because like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes and tired of perpetually playing defense. I won this primary because I played offense, andI’m going to run a relentless full-court press to win this seat in November. I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your support alone , will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than a decade and take back the Senate Majority. Look, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially. But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson. This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now. We have 5 months to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the future. Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost primary victory. The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. **** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. We have a ton of work to do and history to make here in Iowa. Let’s do this. Talk soon, Josh Turek elects Democrats with disabilities. I just released my comprehensive education plan to support our educators,

child is given a world-class education in our public schools.

Michigan’s public schools — and when I’m done, I’d really appreciate it if

public school teachers who taught special education, a mom, and a former
educator, I know what's at stake for Michigan families — and I'm ready to

grade, expanding hands-on learning opportunities, and providing more
post-secondary education opportunities.

clean_body: Our voices and our existence deserve to be celebrated 💖 | | | Hey Peter, What are you doing this Pride and Immigrant Heritage Month?🫂🧡 We know the moment we face is taking A LOT out of every single one of us. Our loved ones are being torn from our communities every day. Our DACA recipient neighbors are losing their jobs and income due to long renewal delays. All of this while most of us struggle to make ends meet. Pride Month and Immigrant Heritage Month are a reminder that our unapologetic voices are meant to be heard. Our existence itself tells the story of the resilience and courage that runs deep in our communities. Even in the darkest moments, our stories bring hope, comfort, and purpose. ** to be in community, and discover how everyday people (like us) can transform fear into power to build the home we need. 🏡🧡 Will I see you there? Here’s what to expect when you join our community call on June 22: 📕 Join us for a panel with UWD co-founder and author Cristina Jimenez, moderated by award-winning poet & novelist Sandra Cisneros! Cristina's memoir Dreaming of Home: How We Turn Fear into Pride, Power and Real Change is a love letter to immigrant journeys and calls on us to use the power of our voice to build change. 🤫 Catch a special performance from La Diva Más Latina, Geneva Karr, in honor of Pride Month! 👀🌈 Our joy and our existence is symbol of our resistance. 🎁 Walk away with a special gift from us to feel empowered in our journey for justice and dignity Peter, if we want to make it through this moment, we need each other, we need joy, and we need community. See you there, Ximena and the UWD team | Follow us on: | | | | |

# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4917%2E898137%2ESklIFP)
From the outset of this campaign, I made a choice: I’m refusing corporate PAC money.
That choice was deliberate.
The fact that running for the U.S. Senate requires raising millions upon millions of dollars is fundamentally broken. It drives regular people crazy, it keeps good leaders out of government, and honestly, it is exhausting. You shouldn’t have to build a multi-million dollar war chest just to have a voice in our democracy.
But until we change the laws and fix this broken system, we have to play by the rules that exist. And right now, the choice is clear: you either fund your campaign through thousands of grassroots donors, or you let corporate PACs and billionaires buy a piece of you.
We have the largest grassroots campaign of anyone in this race. That’s all because of people like you. I don’t take that lightly.
But right now, Republicans are willing to spend whatever it takes to flip this seat red. They’ve already got $45 million in ads booked from super PACs.
I know that together, we can beat them and stand up to MAGA mega donors, but only if I have you by my side.
**[So, are you with me? If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make your first contribution to this campaign, this is it. | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us4.campaign-archive.com/?e=a4a0e00aa9&i=de7631ef11&u=0d904575982951bb382fbe118&id=397da3fe96)
