* * *
* * *
Mayor DiBlasio continued the war on roads with his endless dedicated bike and bus lanes. Now, with no significant change in the number of cars on its road over the last 20 years, NYC has massive congestion problem. Queens Boulevard (made famous from the Mark Wahlberg show) was 12 lanes: three in the main road, three in the service road, in both directions, a major thoroughfare across Queens. It is now half that, and traffic hell, in both directions. In Manhattan, 8th Avenue was four-lanes. You could hail a cab at Penn Station (34th Street) and catch the lights right, be at 72nd Street in minutes. Today, it is two-lanes of bumper to bumper hell.
Government's solution: a tax. A $9 congestion tax because government caused it, but you are going to pay for it.
Progress!
What's the war on roads really about? Cars. The left hates cars because they hate freedom. They hate autonomy and the free movement of free peoples, and cars enable all of that. Cars must be canceled. They cannot make them illegal so they will make them so incredibly inconvenient and expensive, that eventually you will give them up.
"No Kings", right?
What does the left love? The state. And nothing is more a sign of the state than public transportation and government owned and operated buses and trains. It gives government dominion over you and makes you subject to them. The state decides your movement, times and stops, routes and stations. Leftists see an old lady waiting for a bus and don't see inconvenience or inefficiency or even indignity. They see compliance. They see the machine at work and relish a subservient, powerless cog in the state machine, subjugated, waiting, dependent, asking please, sir, may I ride your bus?
Your car competes with the state itself. Your ability to come and go as you please, move as you please, independent of them... why, it's downright frightening. In fact, it could be a threat to our democracy.
Eliminate the cars to lessen the freedom. Eliminate the cars to increase the dependency on the state.
Parking meters were really the first big push. Originally it was a revenue source, but now parking meter rules are punitive. This is a twofer: punish people for being free AND increase state revenue. I distinctly remember a dime getting you an hour of parking as a kid in NYC. Last I saw, it's twenty-five cents for 6 minutes.
You and your car, and the nerve you have thinking you can just park where you want. You can't! And we'll make sure of it. NYC has **[roughly 3,500 full time](https://substack.com/redirect/99af634b-ad17-441e-a2b8-a84076a718a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** ticket-writers generating half a billion dollars in revenue, punishing people for the crime of parking in a place or for a length of time they deem unsuitable. Now, it's muslim Ugandan mayor is proposing to expand parking meters to every available space in the city. Every spot. Imagine that... thinking you can park in front of your own home. You can't! And we'll make sure of it.
I've often mentioned how, when leftists need to enact something sinister, they hide behind children like Hamas firing rockets from schoolyards. In another attempt to kill the car (freedom) New York's foreign born Jihadist mayor lowered the speed limit for several blocks around schools to 15 miles per hour. Though there have been no reported cases of children getting hit by cars outside school... it doesn't matter. Who doesn't want to protect children? So, in a city with several thousand schools, basically the entire city is now 15mph.
But not buses. No, dedicated bus lanes can go, go, go! And you can, too, if you only stopped being so stubborn and gave up your car for the greater good of society.
It's not just New York. Basically every city is doing this because every city is run by leftists. Chuck Todd, the unpopular and unlikeable former _Meet the Press_ anchor and regular on MS whatever it's called now babbler, tweeted that President Trump's vanity projects were causing traffic throughout Washington, DC. "Not sure this admin cares how they disrupt life in the area" he whined.
Except it's not true. The "vanity projects" like the Columbus Fountain restoration or the reflecting pool at the Lincoln Memorial haven't blocked off one street. Dupont Circle stated completely open while the fountain was repaired. So did Freedom Plaza. So did Pennsylvania Avenue in front of the Navy Memorial. And Lafayette Park hasn't had traffic since it was closed to cars after 9/11 let alone any traffic near the ballroom.
But what has changed throughout DC and impacted traffic patterns? Bus lanes and bike lanes everywhere. Pennsylvania Avenue NW is down several. K street NW is down lanes and also at a crawl of 20mph speed limit (probably because of the children). 15th Street NW along the Treasury Department is a nightmare with scooter lanes and pedestrian lanes, because all those bankers going to see Secretary Bessent are taking an E-Bike to their meeting. Who doesn't love to work up a sweat wearing a suit and tie?
But Chuck would never call out the reason for traffic in DC. In his leftist heart he must protect the progressive agenda of turning roads into vehicles for forced equity by eliminating vehicles altogether. For when we are all sweaty and gross at a bus stop in the heat or stuck underground like moles waiting for the subway to gobble us up, when we are all waiting for a bus or a train, and we vote for increased funding for buses and trains because we are now completely reliant on the state to get us from point A to point B, then we will all be equal. Browbeaten, yes, but docile as we ask our elected leaders to drive us somewhere like we once asked dad. The state... as a parent. The state... taking care of us. Providing for us. Forever their children.
The left hates your freedom. Look at all the many ways you exercise freedom and how the same leftist have attacked it. Remember when Joe Biden proposed a minister of truth to oversee what is said online? Remember the vitriol that Twitter now called X is no longer censoring speech. Look at attacks on the second amendment... for the children, of course. Wherever you can exercise freedom is the left trying to curtail it "for democracy".
You exercise your freedom with your car. But they run the roads, and they will set the rules trying to drive you off the road and into their arms. My advice: talk radio. Books on tape. Find a subject and do a deep dive. There's a 100+ episode podcast on ancient Rome where they talk a lot about the roads. What I mean is: stay in your car. Put up with the traffic. Don't give up your car. Don't give up your freedom!
**Honor and courage.**

Team,
Dan Meuser made millions from his family's wheelchair company, whose whole pitch is that they accept payments from Medicare and Medicaid.
**He profited off taxpayer-funded Medicaid money and then voted for the largest Medicaid cut in history.**
Dan, we have questions.
Why is it OK for him to take our federal health care dollars, but not his constituents? Why did he vote to kick 30,000 people in our part of the state off their insurance? Why did he vote for a bill that he knows will threaten our rural hospitals and put even more strain on our local economies?
[KICK MEUSER OUT OF CONGRESS](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8edf1a-6f16-4ebe-b5c5-c3ec65cb1d40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I talk to a lot of people here in our part of Pennsylvania on the campaign trail. Nearly every conversation I have about health care is devastating.
**Families are struggling to afford health insurance on top of all the high costs - and it's because Dan voted for this.**
I'm running to reverse Dan's cuts and make health care affordable. That means holding insurance companies accountable, banning prior authorizations, and stopping health insurance executives from making a fortune by raising your premiums.

Son of 1776 needs your support to reach millions of young Americans with the true story of America's founding.
[ ](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=95795107d6774a0dae90278840c42a10&_e=laiCJxB52I5BzALAmQGVItPDj_QC6psiCReWK6cydX5DVQadhLlqEcayXtNhLiBYOcH40f3DjFW8cTxmLeTebbvI7Vy8mrLkTD_SVOqTIAPjJSXAyzl9RSZmg6EHn9TTvYzc5gDljlN2v6quvlxLEitUO082T6IcEd1PuD51Bdtg7jVR9piK81QuVyatRd1kzfZSmx_vxZTJ61A__6bFjyCns-sfAUAEHInYqaOsmTBde5gz6G8txvnM8qCQaYTAKcveRfmV_8bEItpf6yrrRjW4BXlbrYBvEm3g4nfLuvwW3BJuqvarbWWfhcjUEIK5bhdD4NDejjjQTssXYiv_s_Kv9kcoOGXohZCe4FVo84iAntJulmmbMf-BC4tIu7haMYVGt4k4ISK_QxYbcZ59uZ7oRv8JdMiupceCniH0tkdHrBfSD6eOB2azpoGDaKqKKvxCd5tBE7F9-SKzt8BQmUVZRLrJdR-XajbOtk_rZEaOIvwowNcl7k0TtEyXu8QoAk-8evtoqeQZzsWGUIbbqyavkyD9mPvxYo939oshhgXLD7Sb9gwEaOpd7qbSIO6SAWgZg7jbCyVKA470xSP5DRzFDZ5DR03IBWI8MIjzhlkp1I_Fi-QZ4reCo-KSbDv1gYLPVGcdZLwy1gxilQXD_D4hCLZ8TZmA4AXPWGLWvic%3D)
Hi there,
The way we teach history shapes how the next generation sees America—and right now, that story is changing.
This past Wednesday, I took a closer look at how American history is presented in classrooms today. And what I found was striking. According to a Northwestern University Institute for Policy Research survey, 73% of Americans are dissatisfied with the way the subject is taught in public schools.
That stat tells you everything—parents across the political spectrum recognize that something is wrong.
As you know, these new curricula emphasize systemic challenges and injustices. **Students graduate without understanding the full story—the courage, sacrifice, and vision that built this nation. That's one reason the work of the Moving Picture Institute (MPI) matters so much to me. At MPI, we make movies that highlight the ideals of freedom, character, and service, and help bring these important stories to life for new audiences.**
And this matters more now than ever before. A generation is growing up without access to the stories and films that you and I had. We grew up with movies like _D-Day_ , _Davy Crocket_ , _The Alamo_ , _Top Gun_ —heck, just 20 years ago they made _The Patriot_.
But MPI is counteracting that by making a movie for families with children.
**Son of 1776** is an animated film where a young patriot joins George Washington and experiences the American Revolution. Children and families will see the bravery and sacrifice that forged this great nation. This is a movie that WILL celebrate America's 250th birthday.
**[But we need your support to make it happen. clean_body: They're Not Teaching Our Kids the Truth Son of 1776 needs your support to reach millions of young Americans with the true story of America's founding. Hi there, The way we teach history shapes how the next generation sees America—and right now, that story is changing. This past Wednesday, I took a closer look at how American history is presented in classrooms today. And what I found was striking. According to a Northwestern University Institute for Policy Research survey, 73% of Americans are dissatisfied with the way the subject is taught in public schools. That stat tells you everything—parents across the political spectrum recognize that something is wrong. As you know, these new curricula emphasize systemic challenges and injustices. Students graduate without understanding the full story—the courage, sacrifice, and vision that built this nation. That's one reason the work of the Moving Picture Institute (MPI) matters so much to me. At MPI, we make movies that highlight the ideals of freedom, character, and service, and help bring these important stories to life for new audiences. And this matters more now than ever before. A generation is growing up without access to the stories and films that you and I had. We grew up with movies like D-Day , Davy Crocket , The Alamo , Top Gun —heck, just 20 years ago they made The Patriot. But MPI is counteracting that by making a movie for families with children. Son of 1776 is an animated film where a young patriot joins George Washington and experiences the American Revolution. Children and families will see the bravery and sacrifice that forged this great nation. This is a movie that WILL celebrate America's 250th birthday. | | ---|---|--- | | Sincerely, Joseph Corey Vice President of Philanthropic Investments The Moving Picture Institute | 375 Greenwich Street New York NY 10013

Folks, Yesterday, I joined thousands of people at Motor City Pride in Detroit! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132955587/626242597/-1809995024?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260608_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYmYzZjc4Y2MtODY2My1mMTExLThmY2ItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CcQGWbSGXhV_mseFn0BZiYI8rCDJhHpygPrxfyOEtHc=) It was a great day, and a powerful reminder of what makes Michigan special. People from different backgrounds, different communities, and different walks of life came together to celebrate the simple idea that everyone deserves the freedom to be themselves. As governor, I've worked to make Michigan a state where that freedom is protected. We've expanded civil rights protections for LGBTQ+ Michiganders, prohibited state funding for conversion therapy, and established Michigan's first statewide LGBTQ+ commission. Those accomplishments matter because they make a real difference in people's lives. Now that the November ticket in Texas is set (and Election Day is 20 weeks away, which we promise you will go by much faster than you think), you’ll be hearing more from #TeamLizzie about what we’re getting up to at Campaign HQ.
May brought the end of the Texas primaries with runoffs at the end of the month, and more bad news from the Supreme Court. With the primary elections behind us and the ticket set, #TeamLizzie is focused on supporting the Democratic ticket in Texas. In the last few weeks, we’ve caught up with Democrats full of energy following Christian Menefee's win in the 18th Congressional District, James Talarico’s visit to Houston to kick off his The People vs. Ken Paxton Tour , and the big Harris County Democratic Party Block Party at Discovery Green.

subject: Get your FREE “God's Children Are Not For Sale” t-shirt
body:
Make your first gift today and receive a FREE “God's Children Are Not For Sale” t-shirt as our thank-you.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7463286/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvNzhCeTRGR0NnSw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MDg/LbmNsamtCU04weQ/qP2hpZHM9bmN4MUJ0eXFidWJCQU5scw/gaidAjw/sdh78747659)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| |
---
| | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | | Friend, I want to start with two simple words. **Thank you.** Thank you for caring about children you may never meet. Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. **Every day.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**God's children are not for sale.** And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** today, we'll send you a FREE white **"God's Children Are Not For Sale"** t-shirt as our thank-you.
---
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the **Sound of Freedom Foundation.** People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: **"No more."** Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. **A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity.** And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. **Most of all Friend, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself.** A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. **Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color.**
---
[ Protect God's Children Today ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verástegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**
---
[ Protect God's Children Today ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, _"Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these."_ (Matthew 19:14) **Every child is precious in God's eyes.** **Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth.** And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ Protect God's Children Today ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
When you make your first gift today, you help:
---
* **Prevent exploitation** by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children.

* **Support intervention efforts** by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation.

* **Educate parents and communities** about the warning signs traffickers use to target children.

* **Raise awareness** so more people understand the reality of this crisis.

* **Advocate for stronger protections** for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers.

---
This is how change happens. **One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet.** **Today, that person can be you.**
---
[ Protect God's Children Today ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Will you make your first gift now? **[Please make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can today to help protect vulnerable children from exploitation and trafficking.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Choose your shirt size and select a color. **And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most.** Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. **Thank you for choosing action over silence**. With gratitude and prayer,
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**P.S.** Your FREE "**God's Children Are Not For Sale** " t-shirt is available only for a limited time and only while supplies last. Please make your first gift today, choose your size, and join a growing movement committed to protecting vulnerable children. Every child matters. Every child deserves freedom.
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074
---

name: Dennis Price, Heroes for Humanity
subject: This is the moment most people never see
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heroes for Humanity
body:
A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere.

| | | | | |
---
[ ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=fb07e30276664dcbbf75981963c8e4ed&_e=hyRmnBqnWRVn_Yjq4fW-NkCo2MQ1DkYcGaU6TEzyZRDg8vijcEFCo4IwKFJ83GnzSaZ_22KkBs_H3HcUp0ZfmyO6WZjMEppDD18GOrRzjHxnt6UZhfxxmkxV5NMd3sR5pGxx9vTLv28InslYEgsSbwGId5bgo2qc-5Vr97GhTk1DzE-dWePhHsY6dM1599expvTwPeegpvNieSKN6khkg9FaqqPKrfjXnkoUU5d_jxUM8UHFcbIahqhC1SBg1rIQFD-iW8BCclewfgNdJBOVfFe4EV5NXEuX3tRdezrZocajRUSne5NWFrjtv5DIN6ZVCa_sEoGTF2fuGOcu20xj0dolWPNFdzFFB78OQpvwzCG863qLGMCNYWEqlvnkcwJG7r4It5kdc6JGTdRUIT5feWecNgV8_HghuCs737HjBTvUwWmNseOlA8O9DPtAZgBe2nITRWjXK0ViYodru2sWyYjLJAFeg_kYkzWwnzY9P3iGURb_rjdqzwThmjDB5TVHHLgzLDVLx5Bd8PhBve7ulIydc48QqCVKdjxqhAF2B850tTdGqRxjhTqZHNwKLAL0qBE0TplNNC-gms8ZSyCiVnggTux-kt4UKZdYAT9dernbxJb-ixrds12Re_3EWrS093BzgwPk9onUxZPvV1yS2AuUbi5lUWzKp4O09KrRlZBtG2rdZeS4gm0RVakgKgArProHPz9gtyjg1hCic8gyfg%3D%3D)
---
Friend,
"Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. Nobody was helping. In her words, she was flabbergasted and lost, terrified for her daughter, with no idea what to do next.
**That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for.**
We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting.
Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home.
**Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse.**
I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare.
You can likely count on one hand the number of nonprofits in this country that actually go hands-on – that physically go in and bring a child out. Most cannot.
**The backbone of Heroes for Humanity is veteran special operators trained to find people who do not want to be found, anywhere in the world.** We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families.
"Abby" is one story among many. We recovered **9 children in California in 2023** , identified more than **8 trafficked children** in our work last year, and brought home **three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas** this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered.
_And trafficking is only one front._ The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth.
**Precision rescue, humanitarian aid, and the hope of Jesus Christ. That is the whole of who we are.**
---
---
**My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments, writing to you as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. **We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work in the trenches that most organizations cannot.
[ **I’d like to ask you to directly support these critical efforts, but I also want to pull back the curtain a bit to share with you exactly how this all works.** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=fb07e30276664dcbbf75981963c8e4ed&_e=hyRmnBqnWRVn_Yjq4fW-NkCo2MQ1DkYcGaU6TEzyZRDg8vijcEFCo4IwKFJ83GnzSaZ_22KkBs_H3HcUp0ZfmyO6WZjMEppDD18GOrRzjHxnt6UZhfxxmkxV5NMd3sR5pGxx9vTLv28InslYEgsSbwGId5bgo2qc-5Vr97GhTk1DzE-dWePhHsY6dM1599expvTwPeegpvNieSKN6khkg9FaqqPKrfjXnkoUU5d_jxUM8UHFcbIahqhC1SBg1rIQKJtTCZ-ryKz08zXjYk7YC4iJFoJaW7xjlXj513-KseITQoQq9uzX7uPnLp-NmU5iSeMLIQZsDeEqrbxCOA06bJxHmJo83k8waCH1_JfBqQQWQGAbrYJ0fD6q740vrqFlXAMhQHXAv5jwjJmPZWbTMb3TL-CnJNRm7dyzeory28WG1Dsz9SRk-YbAnIwHSg0WGUlPcDO-fknRQbCcsMi38yORpcYMqN-UU6pTMOGKcrgzBfTVu7w3pUCAvJz775u-7zm_qhi6RGoMWnijsJXLD5_iuvfPRJBPAaY4nP-Q9kCbhagH5n3JyFO8jz6hsCJdhbknxkWrZn7GuM3WiqBj2qVtngoYr-wjG_jKt9Bw4CXFDb5EoPy7oj-bxX5gAQ6EzE3jxU5LpsSup5KrjZ6wedUVSL_qaYGOhGc5qYTsAqoFgot2ucaoM2b7Eh3QgDJP4sGUHvULIWiDEGPJdaRaYQ%3D%3D) We've put together a short video, with an intro from my dear friend Chad Robichaux, that gets into the tactics, the operators, and the full story of how we brought "Abby" home. [ **Watch it here >>** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=fb07e30276664dcbbf75981963c8e4ed&_e=hyRmnBqnWRVn_Yjq4fW-NkCo2MQ1DkYcGaU6TEzyZRDg8vijcEFCo4IwKFJ83GnzSaZ_22KkBs_H3HcUp0ZfmyO6WZjMEppDD18GOrRzjHxnt6UZhfxxmkxV5NMd3sR5pGxx9vTLv28InslYEgsSbwGId5bgo2qc-5Vr97GhTk1DzE-dWePhHsY6dM1599expvTwPeegpvNieSKN6khkg9FaqqPKrfjXnkoUU5d_jxUM8UHFcbIahqhC1SBg1rIQ5bbwd3VasjnZg-WO8wgMSO2Wf8rXySkOmyAFirZcUOys14wcezbDVIx-T6RXmZfBmU-CttcWATt5XBIoOxPcDtAGrjZya0xRxjVIP8vq-KvCwkdH1ABD6bZEvsWg0U7HFdL_IveOYvGgsf-_KutWGyp_yi4Z5q4tCvKL64mfWd0BYS0nD70u9qpAZJDhWMXwhLVvO-L9p_5pNjFnVLmGUeRnAQN_TPYWYjHpCenVThJnpyp3pJnzQHUzZk6Xfs4AURWFYUZn_2VJRifWzNn9Zb0O485F9ITqMcYEOvTF9JYJjWacgDwCeZo2jev1fgXODVpA1rvis7proYJlrnILKXW3-c7yaxm6dXe8lAI7b6yf0y5UhC6-tVG2wWJo2J_fzpRC3_YheY2jr8y36hqTghNJbkbN5U64FcOSSFkC94xl5K8P3H25-oJOsnwSqnd34exU9lYbnexuHWBbtToX3A%3D%3D)
**And know this, when you give today, you’re not just funding some generic mission. You’re directly funding tangible programs.** Right now, the two that are front and center are as follows:
**➡️ Our July operator course. **This July we launch the next course in our training pipeline, where candidates are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure and trained in the fieldcraft, intelligence work, and crisis response the mission demands. This is where operators are made. Rescues like the one you just read about do not happen without it.
**➡️ The National Training Center. **For five years we've done this work from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we're building a permanent home for the mission in our home state of Texas – standardized certification for every operator we field, medical and trauma training for austere environments, an intelligence and mission-planning hub, and the capacity to train the next generation at scale.
**Long story short, your gift today funds the brick and mortar place, and the training, that puts the right person in the field when the next call comes.**
[ **A donation of any amount would be a true blessing – even $25. The next missing child is already out there. Please, help us be ready.** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=fb07e30276664dcbbf75981963c8e4ed&_e=hyRmnBqnWRVn_Yjq4fW-NkCo2MQ1DkYcGaU6TEzyZRDg8vijcEFCo4IwKFJ83GnzSaZ_22KkBs_H3HcUp0ZfmyO6WZjMEppDD18GOrRzjHxnt6UZhfxxmkxV5NMd3sR5pGxx9vTLv28InslYEgsSbwGId5bgo2qc-5Vr97GhTk1DzE-dWePhHsY6dM1599expvTwPeegpvNieSKN6khkg9FaqqPKrfjXnkoUU5d_jxUM8UHFcbIahqhC1SBg1rIQQyW0ukYLKcDyfbDmFBy8tRviyGyBu0DrBuG-GfXdTfouffVfmFsb-awmkVU3B9gSnd1HifiecHXkXz59fEMm-s3HK5NkmW04AQXgLEm5FBkSSImDRNXwImFzwOGIU-FsovNSRgCO2SBrRz2NlsX-uwpk36DTzAYZBaV7fOF2wo5s2tmPpp11jfT5ZykiQK7ny6TLdrta6-qSd-NP3rQA8dAO3HHE9OXcZWsBcobr_-iMFjPoNPBqa_LmZDysM9uduSsJtp4XMPIODlg51bSovz0581o0Ba7lDEB0MMC7Ka1sb5E4lD09daDnnPGCStMYrd4T5o__Ad-DUj4iEWQAuXkzF9JWHUcYIj1zCwbbDRmMeSDR5ICEZCNpR0tUBI4RAE7tUkUJe-IClhl5Mk39wpAh0LlWluiXUl51r7TA3F8ssfgO_Cez_iZJJO-8WEjqncKXhSVS_Ll2l_qBe0_Zbg%3D%3D)

clean_body: A girl named "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. | | | | | | Friend, "Abby" was missing. Her mother had done everything right and was getting nowhere. Nobody was helping. In her words, she was flabbergasted and lost, terrified for her daughter, with no idea what to do next. That is the moment most people never see, and the moment Heroes for Humanity was built for. We sent operators in. They started surveillance, built intelligence on the ground, and narrowed the search to a single area. Within 24 hours of our operator arriving, we had a confirmed sighting. Shortly after, he picked her up, called her mother, notified local police, and brought her home. Her mother said it plainly: without our team, nothing would have happened. It would have stayed exactly as it was, or gotten far worse. I want to be honest with you about why this is so rare. You can likely count on one hand the number of nonprofits in this country that actually go hands-on – that physically go in and bring a child out. Most cannot. The backbone of Heroes for Humanity is veteran special operators trained to find people who do not want to be found, anywhere in the world. We use those same skills to find missing and trafficked children, here at home and abroad, and to physically return them to their families. "Abby" is one story among many. We recovered 9 children in California in 2023 , identified more than 8 trafficked children in our work last year, and brought home three more teenagers from trafficking situations in Virginia and West Texas this past January. Each one is a name, a face, a family. And each one is the reason the next call cannot go unanswered. And trafficking is only one front. The same operators who find these children went behind enemy lines to bring families home from Afghanistan, stood up evacuations in active war zones in the Middle East, and put food in the hands of a thousand people a day in Zambia – all while carrying the Gospel into the darkest places on earth. Precision rescue, humanitarian aid, and the hope of Jesus Christ. That is the whole of who we are. My name is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Force Recon scout sniper with two decades of service and 15 overseas deployments, writing to you as Founder and CEO of Heroes for Humanity. We were forged in the fire of the 2021 Afghanistan withdrawal, when I went behind enemy lines to bring 77 Americans and Afghan allies home. Today we are a 501(c)(3) network of veteran special operators, first responders, and medical professionals doing the work in the trenches that most organizations cannot. We've put together a short video, with an intro from my dear friend Chad Robichaux, that gets into the tactics, the operators, and the full story of how we brought "Abby" home. And know this, when you give today, you’re not just funding some generic mission. You’re directly funding tangible programs. Right now, the two that are front and center are as follows: ➡️ Our July operator course. This July we launch the next course in our training pipeline, where candidates are vetted under physical, mental, and spiritual pressure and trained in the fieldcraft, intelligence work, and crisis response the mission demands. This is where operators are made. Rescues like the one you just read about do not happen without it. ➡️ The National Training Center. For five years we've done this work from temporary facilities, borrowed space, and on-the-fly logistics. We made it work because we had to. But demand keeps accelerating, and we cannot train operators fast enough this way. So we're building a permanent home for the mission in our home state of Texas – standardized certification for every operator we field, medical and trauma training for austere environments, an intelligence and mission-planning hub, and the capacity to train the next generation at scale. Long story short, your gift today funds the brick and mortar place, and the training, that puts the right person in the field when the next call comes. Thank you, and let's never forget our mission – to free the oppressed, so others may live. Respectfully submitted, Dennis Price Founder & CEO Heroes for Humanity | | | | "MAKE A GIFT TODAY" | | | | | SERVING THE VULNERABLE. SHARING THE GOSPEL. Working families across the country are taking on extra shifts, stressing about bills, and, quite frankly, some are just trying to hold their lives together month to month, paycheck by paycheck. And what are Republicans doing? They are trying to cut Medicaid for families already struggling with rising costs, and the Trump administration is preparing to spend taxpayer money compensating January 6th rioters. Most Republicans know how backwards that is. Half of them will admit behind closed doors that things are out of control. Then the cameras turn on, and suddenly nobody is willing to say anything. Nobody wants to be the next Republican Trump decides to humiliate for stepping out of line because they’re a bunch of cowards. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. Thanks for standing with us. — Seth for Massachusetts | | | ---|---|--- About Seth Moulton Seth Moulton is a Marine and a Democrat with a mission to bring a new generation of leaders to Congress. I've been quiet about this for exactly as long as it took to verify every word.
Now I'm not quiet anymore.
And neither are the tens of thousands of you who have watched, shared, and commented on my [video about Section 224](https://substack.com/redirect/33b12acc-115a-421a-9690-9c8e0b412d02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The response has been overwhelming. People feel the truth in their bones. More folks than I can count are calling Smith a traitor for this.
Something violent is being done to our country. It is wrong. And Adam Smith is doing it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/98066abd-6d01-4b99-a15b-221d45d10257?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### The Provision
Section 224 of the National Defense Authorization Act. Co-introduced by my opponent, Adam Smith--the top Democrat on the House Armed Services Committee, and a 30-year incumbent--along with Republican Chairman Mike Rogers.
It establishes a Pentagon "executive agent." A single official whose job is to synchronize U.S.-Israel defense technology cooperation. That means:
* Joint weapons research, development, and co-production
* Intelligence sharing, cyber capabilities, and "data fusion"
* Artificial intelligence, autonomous weapons systems, and biotechnology

_This official can override other Pentagon components responsible for technology security._ And once our supply chains fuse with a foreign military, the relationship becomes nearly impossible to unwind. Analysts call it the "lock-in" effect.
I call it a trap.
* * *
### The Betrayal
Congressman Ro Khanna (D-CA) tried to strip Section 224 out of the bill. His amendment failed--by unrecorded voice vote, so no one has to answer for it.
Smith publicly defended keeping it. He told reporters the integration was "to our benefit" and not "bowing to Netanyahu."
Here's what Smith didn't tell you.
**The Pentagon just raised Israel 's espionage threat level to "critical."** Higher than Russia. Higher than China. Israeli intelligence has been caught installing monitoring software on U.S. defense personnel phones. Attempting to place listening devices on Secret Service vehicles. Targeting senior U.S. officials. One official called it "unhinged."
And Adam Smith's response is to propose merging our militaries?
That is not leadership. That is giving the bank robber the vault keys and asking him to manage security.
* * *
### The Donors
Smith says this serves "American interests."
[Let's look at who funds him](https://substack.com/redirect/a1f0bc0b-7c6e-420d-9397-e335d5c2d4f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). AIPAC. Palantir--the surveillance giant. Anduril--the killer robot makers.
**That 's not the American interest.** That's the parasitic military-industrial-surveillance complex. And it is actively destroying our sovereignty, our free speech, and our rule of law.
* * *
### The Voters He Ignores
85% of Democrats believe Israel is committing genocide in Gaza. The same, if not more, oppose sending more military aid. Gallup found only 8% of Democrats approve of Israel's military actions.
These are not fringe views. They are the mainstream of Adam Smith's own party.
But Smith isn't listening to his voters. He's listening to AIPAC.
During the hearing, Rep. Ro Khanna stated on the record that Netanyahu personally pushed for this framework. Khanna's amendment to remove it failed. Days later, on June 5th, **[AIPAC publicly thanked Adam Smith by name](https://substack.com/redirect/5e77e885-c5eb-497d-9b1c-d06069538abf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) --**calling Section 224 a "strategic advantage."
Netanyahu asks. AIPAC lobbies. Smith co-introduces. Measure passes.
The people of Washington's 9th District were never consulted. And in case it's not blindingly obvious: **we would have said no.**
There is a word for an elected official who prioritizes the strategic interests of a foreign government over the documented wishes of his own constituents and the warnings of his own intelligence agencies. That word is not 'bipartisan.' It is not 'pragmatic.' And the people of the 9th District should not have to accept it.
* * *
### The Legal Framework: What "Traitor" Actually Means
Because people keep saying it, and I want to be precise.
The Constitution, Article III, Section 3: _" Treason against the United States, shall consist only in levying War against them, or in adhering to their Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort."_
The federal statute, 18 U.S.C. § 2381: _" Whoever, owing allegiance to the United States, levies war against them or adheres to their enemies, giving them aid and comfort... is guilty of treason."_
The penalty? Not less than five years in prison, a fine, and--most relevant here--**" shall be incapable of holding any office under the United States."**
And then there is the oath. Every member of Congress swears to _" support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic."_
Now ask yourself: When a U.S. Representative co-authors legislation to merge American military supply chains, intelligence systems, and weapons development with a foreign power--a power the Pentagon has just designated a "critical" espionage threat, caught spying on our Secret Service and installing malware on our defense personnel phones--what is he doing?
He is giving that foreign power aid. He is giving it comfort. He is structurally embedding it into our national defense.
I am not a prosecutor. I am a candidate for Congress. But I swore an oath too--when I married into a military family, when I fought the federal government across 4 jurisdictions to free my husband from unlawful ICE detention, and when I decided to run for office to defend the Constitution that is the ground under our feet, the glue that holds us together, our structure in the storm.
So I will use the word carefully, but I will not flinch from it.
Adam Smith has betrayed America. He has abandoned his oath. He has prioritized a foreign government's strategic interests over American security and the documented will of his own constituents.
Whether that meets the legal standard for treason is a question for the Department of Justice.
Whether it meets the moral standard is a question for the voters of the 9th District.
* * *
### What I Believe
I am running against Adam Smith because our district deserves better.
My father served honorably in a distinguished career as a US Naval Commander and physician. My husband served in the US Army and now uses a wheelchair because of injuries sustained on active duty. I know the weight of service. **Adam Smith does not.** He has no family who has ever served. Nor has he himself. And yet he is fast-tracking a permanent military merger with a foreign power--without debate, without conditions, without the American people's consent.
That is not representation. That is betrayal - if not treason.
I believe in three things:
1. **Restore congressional oversight.** No more hiding foreign military integration inside must-pass legislation.
2. **Enforce human rights law.** Weapons transfers must comply with the Leahy Act. Period.
3. **Defend American sovereignty.** No permanent military integration with any foreign government without a public vote and binding conditions.

Care. Courage. The Constitution.
* * *
### How I'm Feeling
People keep asking me if I'm angry.
I'm not angry. I'm furious. But fury is not the end of the sentence. Fury is the beginning.
What is being done to our country is a violation. Not just of a law--but of something more fundamental. The idea that government is Of the People, By the People, For the People. The idea that we, the citizens, get to decide whether our tax dollars and our young people and our moral authority are handed over to any foreign military.
Section 224 takes that decision away from us. It moves us, as a country, from aid we can debate to integration we can barely see.
And the immune response in the American body politic is fierce. As it should be. I see it in every comment, every share, every email.
You feel the betrayal. So do I.
Now let's do something about it.

And once our supply chains fuse with a foreign military, the relationship becomes nearly impossible to unwind. Analysts call it the "lock-in" effect. I call it a trap. The Betrayal Congressman Ro Khanna (D-CA) tried to strip Section 224 out of the bill. His amendment failed--by unrecorded voice vote, so no one has to answer for it. Smith publicly defended keeping it. He told reporters the integration was "to our benefit" and not "bowing to Netanyahu." Here's what Smith didn't tell you. The Pentagon just raised Israel 's espionage threat level to "critical." Higher than Russia. Higher than China. Israeli intelligence has been caught installing monitoring software on U.S. defense personnel phones. Attempting to place listening devices on Secret Service vehicles. Targeting senior U.S. officials. One official called it "unhinged." And Adam Smith's response is to propose merging our militaries? That is not leadership. That is giving the bank robber the vault keys and asking him to manage security. The Donors Smith says this serves "American interests." . AIPAC. Palantir--the surveillance giant. Anduril--the killer robot makers. That 's not the American interest. That's the parasitic military-industrial-surveillance complex. And it is actively destroying our sovereignty, our free speech, and our rule of law. The Voters He Ignores 85% of Democrats believe Israel is committing genocide in Gaza. The same, if not more, oppose sending more military aid. Gallup found only 8% of Democrats approve of Israel's military actions. These are not fringe views. They are the mainstream of Adam Smith's own party. But Smith isn't listening to his voters. He's listening to AIPAC. During the hearing, Rep. Ro Khanna stated on the record that Netanyahu personally pushed for this framework. Khanna's amendment to remove it failed. Days later, on June 5th, --calling Section 224 a "strategic advantage." Netanyahu asks. AIPAC lobbies. Smith co-introduces. Measure passes. The people of Washington's 9th District were never consulted. And in case it's not blindingly obvious: we would have said no. There is a word for an elected official who prioritizes the strategic interests of a foreign government over the documented wishes of his own constituents and the warnings of his own intelligence agencies. That word is not 'bipartisan.' It is not 'pragmatic.' And the people of the 9th District should not have to accept it. The Legal Framework: What "Traitor" Actually Means Because people keep saying it, and I want to be precise. The Constitution, Article III, Section 3: " Treason against the United States, shall consist only in levying War against them, or in adhering to their Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort." The federal statute, 18 U.S.C. § 2381: " Whoever, owing allegiance to the United States, levies war against them or adheres to their enemies, giving them aid and comfort... is guilty of treason." The penalty? Not less than five years in prison, a fine, and--most relevant here--" shall be incapable of holding any office under the United States." And then there is the oath. Every member of Congress swears to " support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic." Now ask yourself: When a U.S. Representative co-authors legislation to merge American military supply chains, intelligence systems, and weapons development with a foreign power--a power the Pentagon has just designated a "critical" espionage threat, caught spying on our Secret Service and installing malware on our defense personnel phones--what is he doing? He is giving that foreign power aid. He is giving it comfort. He is structurally embedding it into our national defense. I am not a prosecutor. I am a candidate for Congress. But I swore an oath too--when I married into a military family, when I fought the federal government across 4 jurisdictions to free my husband from unlawful ICE detention, and when I decided to run for office to defend the Constitution that is the ground under our feet, the glue that holds us together, our structure in the storm. So I will use the word carefully, but I will not flinch from it. Adam Smith has betrayed America. He has abandoned his oath. He has prioritized a foreign government's strategic interests over American security and the documented will of his own constituents. Whether that meets the legal standard for treason is a question for the Department of Justice. Whether it meets the moral standard is a question for the voters of the 9th District. What I Believe I am running against Adam Smith because our district deserves better. My father served honorably in a distinguished career as a US Naval Commander and physician. My husband served in the US Army and now uses a wheelchair because of injuries sustained on active duty. I know the weight of service. Adam Smith does not. He has no family who has ever served. Nor has he himself. And yet he is fast-tracking a permanent military merger with a foreign power--without debate, without conditions, without the American people's consent. That is not representation. That is betrayal - if not treason. I believe in three things: 1. Restore congressional oversight. No more hiding foreign military integration inside must-pass legislation. 2. Enforce human rights law. Weapons transfers must comply with the Leahy Act. Period. 3. Defend American sovereignty. No permanent military integration with any foreign government without a public vote and binding conditions. Care. Courage. The Constitution. How I'm Feeling People keep asking me if I'm angry. I'm not angry. I'm furious. But fury is not the end of the sentence. Fury is the beginning. What is being done to our country is a violation. Not just of a law--but of something more fundamental. The idea that government is Of the People, By the People, For the People. The idea that we, the citizens, get to decide whether our tax dollars and our young people and our moral authority are handed over to any foreign military. Section 224 takes that decision away from us. It moves us, as a country, from aid we can debate to integration we can barely see. And the immune response in the American body politic is fierce. As it should be. I see it in every comment, every share, every email. You feel the betrayal. So do I. Now let's do something about it. () My name is Melissa Chaudhry. I 'm running for Congress in Washington's 9th District. I take No PAC money. No AIPAC money. Just We the People, the way it should be. Subscribe to stay updated. Share this post. Sign up to volunteer on , and chip in if you can. And if you're in the district--register to vote. August 4th is coming.** You 're currently a free subscriber to "It's a Matter of Integrity" by Melissa Chaudhry. body:
This marks the formal start of what will be a competitive race here in New Hampshire.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=7079%2E582294%2EQJLb7d)
Team, it’s official:
**I just filed to put my name on the ballot for the U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.**
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260608_3.THGwAy&refcode=em20260608-3&t=2&akid=7079%2E582294%2EQJLb7d)
Filing Day is an important milestone in this campaign. It marks the formal start of what will be a competitive race here in New Hampshire.
Across the Granite State, I hear about the same challenges again and again: the cost of housing, rising health care expenses, and the pressure everyday costs are putting on hardworking families.
This campaign is focused on those priorities — making life more affordable, protecting access to health care, and making sure New Hampshire remains a place where people can live and work if they choose to do so.
But we also know what we’re up against: **Outside groups are expected to pour millions of dollars into this race, and this seat will be one of the most closely watched races in the country.**
We need to build a strong grassroots foundation right now so we can organize early, reach voters in every corner of the state, and make sure this campaign is defined by Granite Staters — not outside spending or political attacks.
**[If you’re able I’m asking you to make a contribution today — $5 or whatever you can — to help us boost this grassroots-powered campaign and have the resources we need to flip the Senate in November.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260608_3.THGwAy&refcode=em20260608-3&t=3&akid=7079%2E582294%2EQJLb7d)**

Your grassroots support makes a real difference in this race. It allows us to hire organizers, build our outreach programs, and compete from this day forward.
**From here the hard work continues. I hope you’ll join us.**
Thank you for your support.
— Chris
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

clean_body: After Callais, we can't rely on litigation to stop Republican gerrymandering; our best path is to win more majorities in state legislatures to put Democrats on offense. | | | | | ---|--- Hi, it’s DLCC Board Chair Andrea Stewart-Cousins. After the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act in the disastrous Louisiana v. Callais ruling, Republicans have wasted no time rigging maps in their favor. The systematic disenfranchisement of communities of color across the South that Republicans are pursuing hurts our democracy and disrespects the Civil Rights Movement. The Callais decision marks the biggest rollback of Black voting and political power in 150 years. After Callais , we can't rely on litigation to stop Republican gerrymandering; our best path is to win more majorities in state legislatures to put Democrats on offense. Our Democratic trifecta in New York gives our party the power to act strategically and with haste against these attacks on our rights. Under my leadership, state Democrats in New York will go on offense to rebalance the scales. We will do this the right way – we’re pursuing a constitutional amendment to put mid-decade redistricting on the ballot and in the hands of the people. Thanks to the DLCC's work over the last decade to build more Democratic trifectas, blue states like New York are positioned to go on offense to counter GOP redistricting. Peter, I'm pissed off. Republicans control all the levers of power in Washington. And what have they done for working people? _Not a damn thing._ Take one example. Ryan Mackenzie signed on to Trump's budget, slashing Medicaid and putting coverage at risk for millions of people. Meanwhile, they're throwing billions into a war on the other side of the world. _I refuse to be numb to this stuff._ I've spent my life as a firefighter and union leader doing the work that politicians only talk about. Now, I'm running for Congress to give working people a voice. **But flipping this seat is no easy task.** In 2024, PA-07 came down to 4,062 votes. clean_body: I owe my life to the United States of America| | | I never got to use a toilet seat. Instead, we had to share a hole in the ground with 8 other families. I was raised on food rationing coupons in the Sichuan province of China during Mao’s Cultural Revolution. I was only a child, yet I worshiped him like a God. I had no other choice. I was brainwashed. We all were. Eventually, I was able to escape from China and flee to the United States. I spent the next 20 years uninstalling everything Mao’s regime had programmed into my brain, only to discover the very same evil was now being promoted in America and celebrated by the radical left. Then it hit me. I wasn’t just a product of the American Dream - I was also a survivor of Communist rule. My story, my voice, and my campaign endanger everything the Democrats have built their party on - I don’t fit their mold. That’s why I’m humbly asking for your help today. My candidacy & our country truly do depend on it. I hope you’ll do what you can to save both today. Help me make history, Patriot. God Bless America,Lily Tang Williams | | | | Paid for by Lily4Congress Committee | |

# PLYMOUTH NH FUNDRAISER ON JUNE 10TH
and
GRAHAM PLATNER QUESTION

**PLYMOUTH NH FUNDRAISER ON JUNE 10TH**

Please join us on June 10th Wednesday, stop by anytime between 3pm and 6pm at the Common Man Inn. Refreshment will be provided.

Lily’s campaign is built from the ground up by regular, hard-working people who are tired of cost of living increase crushing their household budgets, unchecked government overreach, and the erosion of their liberty.

[Signup for Common Man Event Here](https://us.list-manage.com/PiZNypP_Xoa?e=c338950e03&c2id=adf8b61e01be85c238f26a96cfd7c41c)
Wednesday, June 10 at 3:00 – 6:00 pm Eastern Time
The Common Man Inn Plymouth
231 Main St.
Plymouth, NH

**GOODLANDER SILENCE ON GRAHAM PLATNER**

Here is the gist of my Press Release put out this morning:

Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams today called on Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander to answer a simple question: Does she support Maine Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Graham Platner in light of the constant national news coverage and growing controversy surrounding his campaign?

This top-tier Senate race is happening just over our border. The latest allegations that Platner was physically abusive to his partners are very serious and disturbing. As national and state Democrats continue to rally around Platner's Senate bid, voters deserve to know whether Goodlander, as a woman herself, stands with him and supports his candidacy. Additionally, will Maggie Goodlander condemn organizations that support her, like VoteVets, for also propping up Graham Platner?

"Granite Staters always deserve transparency and honesty from their elected officials," said Williams. "Graham Platner is looking to join Maggie as part of the New England delegation in Congress. Maggie Goodlander should tell voters whether she stands with Graham Platner and whether she believes he is fit to represent Maine in the United States Senate."

"If Maggie Goodlander is willing to campaign alongside Graham Platner, raise money for him, or endorse him, the people of New Hampshire have a right to know," Williams continued. "If she believes his conduct or actions are disqualifying, she should say that too. Remaining silent is not leadership."
Lily Tang Williams emphasized that accountability should apply equally to politicians of both parties. "Public officials should be held to the same standards regardless of party affiliation," said Williams. "Independent-minded Granite State voters expect their leaders to speak clearly and honestly when questions arise about the character and conduct of candidates seeking higher office."

Williams called on Rep. Goodlander to publicly state whether she supports Platner's candidacy and whether she intends to endorse, campaign for, or assist his Senate campaign.

Always yours,

Lily Tang Williams

clean_body: | | | | | | | PLYMOUTH NH FUNDRAISER ON JUNE 10TH and GRAHAM PLATNER QUESTION PLYMOUTH NH FUNDRAISER ON JUNE 10TH Please join us on June 10th Wednesday, stop by anytime between 3pm and 6pm at the Common Man Inn. Refreshment will be provided. Lily’s campaign is built from the ground up by regular, hard-working people who are tired of cost of living increase crushing their household budgets, unchecked government overreach, and the erosion of their liberty. Wednesday, June 10 at 3:00 – 6:00 pm Eastern Time The Common Man Inn Plymouth 231 Main St. Plymouth, NH GOODLANDER SILENCE ON GRAHAM PLATNER Here is the gist of my Press Release put out this morning: Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams today called on Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander to answer a simple question: Does she support Maine Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Graham Platner in light of the constant national news coverage and growing controversy surrounding his campaign? This top-tier Senate race is happening just over our border. The latest allegations that Platner was physically abusive to his partners are very serious and disturbing. As national and state Democrats continue to rally around Platner's Senate bid, voters deserve to know whether Goodlander, as a woman herself, stands with him and supports his candidacy. Additionally, will Maggie Goodlander condemn organizations that support her, like VoteVets, for also propping up Graham Platner? "Granite Staters always deserve transparency and honesty from their elected officials," said Williams. "Graham Platner is looking to join Maggie as part of the New England delegation in Congress. Maggie Goodlander should tell voters whether she stands with Graham Platner and whether she believes he is fit to represent Maine in the United States Senate." "If Maggie Goodlander is willing to campaign alongside Graham Platner, raise money for him, or endorse him, the people of New Hampshire have a right to know," Williams continued. "If she believes his conduct or actions are disqualifying, she should say that too. Remaining silent is not leadership." Lily Tang Williams emphasized that accountability should apply equally to politicians of both parties. "Public officials should be held to the same standards regardless of party affiliation," said Williams. "Independent-minded Granite State voters expect their leaders to speak clearly and honestly when questions arise about the character and conduct of candidates seeking higher office." Williams called on Rep. Goodlander to publicly state whether she supports Platner's candidacy and whether she intends to endorse, campaign for, or assist his Senate campaign. Always yours, Lily Tang Williams Republican Congressional Candidate NH-2 | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2026 LILY4CONGRESS COMMITTEE, All rights reserved._

What I've seen is a district full of good people who are doing their part and wondering why Washington isn't doing the same. That's what this campaign has been about from day one.

Friend, Despite overwhelming opposition, a hyperscale AI data center is being built in Michigan. The vast majority of Saline Township’s residents are against this project, and local officials voted against it multiple times. But billionaire developers threatened to bankrupt the town with lawsuits, forcing the project through. I was disappointed that Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer recently joined OpenAI’s billionaire CEO Sam Altman and other corporate executives to break ground on the data center last week. The American people are clearly against this. Recent polls found that 70% of Americans oppose AI data centers in their communities, and most Michiganders don’t want a data center within 25 miles of their home. [**Please urge governors to stand with the people and protect their communities from AI data centers.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9uJQcRP3UJmwJjPTbEzGm5j5PjVSysDb65mVZ-2rlf_vZAcQF6LvJnKtzEv2J_xjd5RTBDuFN1gChgXDQKzLlrTLWIHvCRA7n9PThbN9MWnyp8Z2YmYDdSDzmIY_7iHFW3OOtLMrnyii16vRkCbIRBF7LvVCKyBHSgjqBSE5JfaNBP_WoRLzEh7POm7AdK5csskbH4atmFwwTdgzmfwYI9WIMwon4K59a5sFE4xd5lTcVWv7A3d5a-mZ7LvHfo2aWBjMy_cl7_4cNZBQ0yv5nNaHNOtvUG2SiwmLeq6AR0kx2uAg_bBwepfLmF0VDROKZcIMR_9fUmGqSSl9uuAt81aGRMl5CvcGMf-2AFT0RtCKAGoAmebOyMk03AFbxpeV6kPZzrM5fi0nxaJp9aYny1A/4rb/GYBtIertQKKa_FeCBFDOOQ/h1/h001.wCo_2icTHPe4chR_kBVBKievlzwz7GjRIw_FC0Im7x8) | [DEMAND GOVS STAND WITH THE PEOPLE](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9uJQcRP3UJmwJjPTbEzGm5j5PjVSysDb65mVZ-2rlf_vZAcQF6LvJnKtzEv2J_xjd5RTBDuFN1gChgXDQKzLlrTLWIHvCRA7n9PThbN9MWnyp8Z2YmYDdSDzmIY_7iHFW3OOtLMrnyii16vRkCbIRBA9C7alr6TJQPP8DZ1Fv_BrN4Az6n3ajK4hXezYhkX22owglkc_b8L5y-bUqRaXDC6tg3LBsFkDAi6D3ovJH9PIdH5HSW1PRXO2x2owXQFSnlKYzvgFbqlXM2OKfrWmlBFZepD9LBpPCaIdS-zEJ26bqKI1RRgrK10xPVXGqR609AB0Z-Uxywm9DFZzkKLx6Pv3_J1y8y9u8IxQmj--erUEX1KfrgJAJyPVblZr4fbkoblYvk7ZhlnkULmyO7EchXA/4rb/GYBtIertQKKa_FeCBFDOOQ/h2/h001.Spq5agXoEJbKH8GOYPaKsh5lrzrIOigw5Wyh-sOGUhQ)

After the photo op in Michigan, Sam Altman came to Washington, D.C. to fight regulation on AI.
Sam Altman has said, _“AI will probably most likely lead to the end of the world, but in the meantime, there’ll be great companies.”_
The largest corporate landlord in our country, Blackstone, also attended last week’s groundbreaking. Blackstone keeps buying up housing, raising rent, and fighting against rent control policies that keep people housed.
**Of course, these corporations don’t have our communities’ interests in mind.** But Michigan state lawmakers still passed a bill that gives tax breaks to corporations for building data centers.
Tax breaks encourage more of these predatory, price-gouging corporate polluters to try to rapidly expand in my home state of Michigan. They’re trying to silence us and override our communities’ demands.
**In response, 51 Michigan towns and cities have enacted moratoriums to temporarily block data centers.** Some put these in place after seeing what would happen with the hyperscale Saline project. It will be the biggest data center in our state, using millions of gallons of water every day.
It will use the same amount of energy as 1 million homes, which is 25% of our notorious utility corporation DTE’s current peak capacity.
That will strain our already-unreliable electric grid, and DTE will very likely shift its costs onto ratepayers—everyday people who are already struggling to pay outrageously high utility bills.
We also know that**data centers bring water, air, noise, and light pollution**. Perpetuating environmental racism, they’re often sited in Black communities, which already experience the highest air-pollution-related mortality rate.1
[**Please add your name to urge governors to protect the people, not Big Tech billionaires who are endangering our health and our planet.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9uJQcRP3UJmwJjPTbEzGm5j5PjVSysDb65mVZ-2rlf_vZAcQF6LvJnKtzEv2J_xjd5RTBDuFN1gChgXDQKzLlrTLWIHvCRA7n9PThbN9MWnyp8Z2YmYDdSDzmIY_7iHFW3OOtLMrnyii16vRkCbIRBAnOolHuUz-I9sKjobFf0vINkKY7FNieLOJ04H5VIwXHpM04htpNrhgdXmvlRNN1uNa6923d8rksvyIASs75xsLhEXkS3lFbytIBsjTkjF47brAddUgaCOef4QIC7uGI-AUGse5x5N_QIrSiltulwy-8DEdw59DGK66qKtO8TWQdsA4aoXcnTzf7SnsRP0RWJkSz8zSZJzrC52LcU0XhrdK1LncAjBnWAefioA0nBEj92j5WJkYHaumk-wZ4AdQ7Rw/4rb/GYBtIertQKKa_FeCBFDOOQ/h3/h001.JbZH3WLemeh1qLKKb1AkKf5lGDFc6RC-U4GGeFy8ZOM)

Last week California held its primary elections, determining the state’s top two governor candidates to be on November’s ballot.
The frontrunners are both backed by massive Big Tech companies that use AI data centers and are pushing to build more.
But a California city just approved a ban on data centers—the first permanent ban in the country.
And in Missouri, a city essentially banned data centers, changing the city rules to block such projects from being built there.
**Some state legislatures are introducing policies to put moratoriums on data center development or to increase oversight and regulations of data centers.**
For example, in Michigan, an ally of mine—State Rep. Dylan Wegela—is taking on DTE and data centers, including cosponsoring bipartisan legislation to regulate and place a statewide moratorium on data centers.
[**Please sign if you agree: Elected officials should listen to the people and support moratoriums to delay AI data center expansion in their states, increase regulation and oversight of data centers, and protect their state’s residents from these projects’ harms.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9uJQcRP3UJmwJjPTbEzGm5j5PjVSysDb65mVZ-2rlf_vZAcQF6LvJnKtzEv2J_xjd5RTBDuFN1gChgXDQKzLlrTLWIHvCRA7n9PThbN9MWnyp8Z2YmYDdSDzmIY_7iHFW3OOtLMrnyii16vRkCbIRBGjY5OrfxRoZDHRjWwhrDBalMLn5Cm1oHdeiAGVeOR3BsObEX1C2KkjuDDNXD_nPe_TOwBE6Ysfh1PgH-QnlYsqRGSx9Ws4Tchp3aScn0mPJddUknHnH5RymIVdttI2GWe02T7HgAfoWwL5lRzVJc69_FCDDVW7Arww4UesNKNBVbDvO7XML4qvhxV6tQ6mmZpe5m2_Y-q-yj0iuucAW_LMmkc-wauKa7glf9Jz7b4okyBaH4Fx7SMWQNp4rGIqz8Q/4rb/GYBtIertQKKa_FeCBFDOOQ/h5/h001.5yNWk3HyVf7qXK0ygGkkx3LhTsAEG7vAFkqn0qYasHA)
Thank you for taking action to rein in these corporate polluters.
In Congress, I’m co-sponsoring the _Artificial Intelligence (AI) Data Center Moratorium Act_ , which would end data centers’ expansion nationwide—until strong safeguards for AI and data centers are put in place to protect communities, workers, and our planet.
I’m also leading the fight in Congress to erase utility debt, lower the cost of life-saving utilities, hold utility companies and other corporate polluters accountable, and bring about environmental justice.
Together, we’ll keep building power to shift our government’s priorities to protect and invest in communities, rather than corporate profits.
Always fighting for you,
Rashida
